title: Retrieve Fasteners From Blind Aisles
description: Carry a 12 kg fastener tote from a blind picking aisle to the packing bench using three modules docked in a 0.6 by 0.2 m line. The 6 m aisle allows forward entry and reverse withdrawal but has no turning space; allow 40 seconds of steady travel in each direction. At the aisle mouth, slide left 0.3 m over 6 seconds to meet the bench.

title: Shuttle Mini Pallets Across Dock
description: Move a 28 kg mini pallet of boxed connectors between two floor-level cross-dock stands on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body. The route includes a 10 m forward crossing with a 40-second cruising allowance, a 1.5 m front-right diagonal through a marked gap in 10 seconds, and a clockwise 90-degree turn in place over 3 seconds. Slide right 0.4 m over 8 seconds to align with the receiving stand.

title: Transfer Totes Beside Guard Rails
description: Move an 8 kg tote from a shelf pickup pad to a packing station with a two-module body oriented 0.4 m along the aisle. Travel forward along the 4 m rail corridor with 25 seconds of steady travel. Keep the same heading while sliding right 0.18 m into the station over 9 seconds, then slide left to clear the receiving lip.

title: Scan Labels Along Reserve Racks
description: Carry a 2.4 kg low-mounted label scanner on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body along a 26 m reserve-rack lane. The scan schedule allows 100 seconds of steady forward travel, requiring nearly full transit speed. At the open end, turn counter-clockwise through 180 degrees over 6 seconds and scan the opposite rack on the return pass.

title: Unload Dense Parts From Trailer
description: Carry a strapped 10 kg case of machine parts from a trailer's flat interior to a receiving pad using two modules. The dock leveler is locked flush with the trailer, and a continuous steel bridge covers the joint without a step. Drive forward 7.2 m with 40 seconds of steady travel, then slide left 0.24 m over 8 seconds at the receiving pad.

title: Rush Samples Through Cold Storage
description: Take a 1.6 kg insulated sample box from a freezer staging pad to the internal quality hatch on a two-module body. The dry, straight aisle provides a 13 m forward leg with 50 seconds of steady travel to limit cold exposure. Keep the box facing the hatch and slide right 0.3 m over 5 seconds for handoff.

title: Feed Motor Kits To Conveyor
description: Carry a 20 kg tray of motor kits from the mezzanine assembly bench to a stopped conveyor loading pad on a four-module square body. Both points are on the same flat mezzanine, separated by an 8.4 m lane with 60 seconds of steady forward travel. At the fenced loading bay, turn clockwise 90 degrees over 6 seconds and slide left 0.2 m over 10 seconds to present the tray.

title: Move Returned Battery Tool Cases
description: Move a 9.5 kg secured tool case from returns intake to the electrical inspection table on a two-module body. Cross the open sorting square diagonally front-left for 3.6 m with 30 seconds of steady travel, keeping the case handle facing the inspector. Slide right 0.4 m over 10 seconds into the table recess and reverse 1.2 m over 12 seconds after unloading.

title: Align Tray With Mobile Racking
description: Bring a 6 kg stock tray into the locked-open channel of a mobile rack using three modules in a 0.6 by 0.2 m line. Advance 2.4 m with 30 seconds of steady travel, then use the widened end pocket to correct heading clockwise by 4 degrees over 4 seconds. Slide left 0.06 m over 6 seconds and creep forward the final 0.12 m over 12 seconds to align the tray with the pickup fixture.

title: Deliver Pharmacy Cell Cassettes
description: Carry a 2.2 kg sealed prescription cassette between two guarded dispensers using one module. Follow the 2.1 m channel forward with 30 seconds of steady travel; its 0.26 m width leaves little room beside the cassette. At the receiving pocket, slide right 0.08 m over 8 seconds, then reverse along the channel after the cassette is removed.

title: Search Cleared Collapsed Corridor
description: Send a four-module square body carrying a 1.8 kg camera and listening unit from the incident doorway to a search position beyond a damaged partition. Responders have cleared a flat 12.5 m corridor strip, allowing 50 seconds of steady forward travel. At the clear end pocket, move diagonally front-left 1 m over 10 seconds to look around the partition without touching debris.

title: Check Offices Through Smoke
description: Carry a 1.2 kg thermal camera and gas sensor along a smoke-filled office corridor on three modules arranged in a line. A previously surveyed 10.4 m carpeted lane has a 40-second steady-travel allowance before the first office. In the clear lobby, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 3 seconds, then slide left 0.6 m over 10 seconds to view through the doorway.

title: Survey Garage Debris Perimeter
description: Take a 0.9 kg inspection camera to a marked observation point beside fallen garage panels using two modules. The route follows a swept, level strip through the debris field, including a 6.5 m front-right diagonal with 25 seconds of steady travel. Reverse 2 m along a straight cleared spur with 10 seconds of steady travel to inspect the back of a parked vehicle.

title: Probe Flooded Basement Dead Ends
description: Use a four-module square body to carry a 2 kg water-depth probe and camera down two blind basement passages. Each passage has a 3 m forward approach and reverse withdrawal with 50 seconds of steady travel per leg because a thin layer of water hides the floor markings. Between passages, slide right 0.8 m over 20 seconds across the flat connecting bay without turning.

title: Inspect Tunnel Cross Passages
description: Carry a 1.4 kg directional camera and crack light along the flat pedestrian strip of a quake-affected utility tunnel using two modules. Travel forward between three inspection pockets, covering 4.8 m between stops with 30 seconds of steady travel. At each pocket, turn in place 90 degrees clockwise to inspect a cross passage and 90 degrees counter-clockwise to resume, allowing 2 seconds per turn.

title: Stage Evacuation Supplies At Bays
description: Deliver a 7 kg tray of evacuation masks and identification bands to three staffed refuge bays using three modules in a line. Move forward along 3 m corridor sections with 25 seconds of steady travel, stopping whenever a bed crosses the route. In each widened bay, turn in place 90 degrees toward the receiving nurse over 5 seconds and turn back after handoff, using both turning directions along the route.

title: Carry Samples Across Stair Landing
description: Move a 1.1 kg padded carrier of glass air-sampling vials from the landing door to a responder's collection pad using one module. Stay entirely on the flat landing, advancing 1.2 m with 30 seconds of steady travel before sliding left 0.3 m over 15 seconds around the door swing. Keep the carrier heading fixed and use gentle starts to protect the vials.

title: Map Warehouse Fire Residue
description: Carry a 2.5 kg residue-imaging unit down a released warehouse aisle using two modules. The swept aisle provides a 24 m straight run with 100 seconds of steady forward travel while the unit records floor discoloration. Keep the same heading and reverse the full length at the same cruising speed to compare the return images.

title: Deliver Glass Medical Cartridges
description: Move a 3 kg cushioned case of glass medication cartridges from one vestibule to a responder station inside a stationary train carriage using two modules. Follow the level aisle forward for 5.4 m with 90 seconds of steady travel, then slide right 0.24 m over 12 seconds into a cleared seat bay. Reverse 0.6 m over 15 seconds after handoff without turning near the seats.

title: Dock Refuge Communications Battery
description: Carry a 6 kg communications battery to a floor-level docking cradle inside a mine refuge chamber using two modules. After a 2.4 m forward approach with 20 seconds of steady travel, approach the angled cradle diagonally front-left for 0.9 m over 30 seconds without changing heading. Once staff remove the battery, withdraw diagonally rear-right along the same line.

title: Measure Cold Aisle Airflow
description: Carry a 3.2 kg low-profile airflow instrument through a data-centre cold aisle on a four-module square body. Travel forward 9 m with 75 seconds of steady travel between rack-door edges. At each of two recessed measurement stations, slide left 0.1 m over 10 seconds toward the rack face and slide right to return to the aisle centerline without yawing.

title: Inspect Inverter Cabinet Seams
description: Move a 1.7 kg thermal camera along the service strip between inverter cabinets and a cable guard inside the inverter room using two modules in a line. Advance 3.6 m with 40 seconds of steady travel, keeping the camera pointed at the cabinet seams. At the widened inspection notch, slide right 0.12 m over 6 seconds and left again to change the viewing angle without turning.

title: Inspect Beneath Wing Service Bay
description: Carry a 2.8 kg upward-facing camera and lamp beneath an aircraft wing on three modules arranged in a line. Enter a 4.2 m blind lane between service stands with 35 seconds of steady forward travel, stop for imaging, and reverse out with 42 seconds of steady travel because the rear clearances are harder to judge. Once clear of the stands, slide left 0.6 m over 10 seconds to reach the equipment collection pad.

title: Record Engine Room Gauge Faces
description: Carry a 4.5 kg directional acoustic sensor and gauge camera between four machinery inspection pockets on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body. Follow the level engine-room deck forward in 3.3 m sections with 30 seconds of steady travel. At each clear pocket, turn in place through 120 degrees over 4 seconds to face a gauge bank, then turn back, using clockwise and counter-clockwise yaw.

title: Survey Turbine Hall Bearing Stations
description: Carry a 7.5 kg vibration recorder and thermal camera between floor-level bearing inspection stations in the turbine hall on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body. Travel forward 12 m with 50 seconds of steady travel, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 3 seconds in a marked bay, and move diagonally front-right 2.4 m over 15 seconds around a fixed instrument pedestal. Slide left 0.2 m over 10 seconds for the reading, then reverse 1.2 m over 10 seconds to clear the station.

title: Pipe Gallery Gauge Survey
description: Carry a camera and lamp on a 2x2 body through a level pipe gallery, following an 8 m straight service passage. At three gauge banks, slide left toward the pipes and right back to the travel line without changing heading; allow 12 seconds for each 0.3 m approach. Reverse along the passage after the last reading because there is no turning pocket.

title: Enclosed Bridge Walkway Instrument Delivery
description: Move a 14 kg ultrasonic inspection kit along the enclosed, level underside walkway inside a box-girder bridge. The three-module body travels 16 m forward to the technician, then reverses 2 m into a marked waiting recess without turning. Allow about two minutes for the loaded outward leg and pause at each steel plate joint.

title: Nacelle Borescope Head Transfer
description: Carry a fragile borescope head in a foam cradle across 3 m of the turbine's stationary, level nacelle floor. Keep the two-module body facing the gearbox and slide 0.24 m right into the technician's receiving position, allowing 10 seconds for that final movement. Slide left clear after unloading and reverse to the storage position.

title: Cleanroom Particle Counter Circuit
description: Carry a particle counter between three marked sampling locations in a cleanroom bay with approved wheel covers. Travel 6 m forward, slide left 0.6 m beside a tool face, then move 1.4 m diagonally front-right through an open bay intersection. Turn 90 degrees clockwise in the marked clear square in about six seconds before the final forward approach.

title: Parking Column Scan Traverse
description: Carry a low laser scanner and its battery on a 2x3 body down a closed, level parking-structure lane. Traverse 48 m forward in about 190 seconds, stopping at four columns for scans. At the far end, turn 180 degrees counter-clockwise inside a 2 m clear square and drive forward back to the start.

title: Ward Supply Alcove Delivery
description: Deliver sealed dressing packs along a 14 m hospital corridor to a dead-end supply alcove. The three-module body enters the alcove forward for 1.8 m and reverses the same distance after staff remove the tray. In the corridor's clear junction, turn 90 degrees counter-clockwise to return toward central stores.

title: Banquet Crockery Corridor Transfer
description: Move 18.6 kg of stacked crockery in a latched low crate from the service pantry to a hotel banquet staging point 22 m down a carpeted corridor. Use a four-module square body and allow about two minutes for the straight forward trip. At the destination, slide 0.5 m right into a wall-side receiving space without rotating the crate.

title: Baggage Exception Pocket Retrieval
description: Enter a 3 m dead-end pocket beneath a stopped baggage inspection spur with an empty four-module body. Staff place a single 16 kg suitcase on the restrained deck, then the body reverses fully out without yawing. Slide 1.1 m left across the clear service lane to the exception desk, allowing about 10 seconds for the lateral transfer.

title: Assembly Fixture Kit Exchange
description: Carry a 17.4 kg fixture kit forward along an 11 m factory service lane and into a 2.2 m dead-end line-side berth. Keep the four-module body aligned with the machine while an operator exchanges the kit for an empty tray. Reverse out through the same berth and lane; allow about a minute of travel in each direction.

title: Library Return Bin Express
description: Move a secured 19 kg book bin from the return desk to sorting along a 36 m straight staff corridor. The four-module body makes the forward run in about 145 seconds, with no sideways movement or turns. After unloading, reverse the empty bin along the same unobstructed route.

title: Laboratory Sample Carrier Circuit
description: Carry a secured insulated sample carrier on a 2x3 body through a laboratory's level transfer room. Go forward 9 m, turn 90 degrees counter-clockwise in a 1.5 m clear square, and move 2 m diagonally front-left around a fixed bench corner. Slide right 0.4 m into the receiving position, then reverse 0.8 m after staff unload the carrier.

title: Backroom Cosmetics Cubby Restock
description: Carry a 4.3 kg cosmetics carton into a 2.6 m dead-end backroom aisle between storage cages. The single module approaches forward, stops for staff to lift the carton, then reverses to the entrance because it cannot turn beneath the projecting shelves. Allow about 20 seconds for each travel leg.

title: Interior Slab Survey Kit Delivery
description: Deliver an 11 kg survey kit across a cured, level indoor construction slab on a three-module strip body. Travel forward 7 m, move 3.2 m diagonally front-right through a cleared gap between material stacks, then turn 90 degrees clockwise in an open work square. Slide left 0.7 m alongside the survey station for unloading.

title: Studio Camera Dolly Reset
description: Carry a 2.8 kg compact camera rig on a three-module dolly across a level studio floor. Between takes, move 12 m diagonally rear-right to the next floor mark within 49 seconds without changing the camera heading. During the take, slide left 2 m over about 38 seconds for a slow tracking shot.

title: Museum Label Supply Traverse
description: Carry a 2.2 kg tray of replacement labels and mounting supplies along a 42 m straight museum gallery after closing. Drive forward to the conservator's worktable in about three minutes, keeping clear of exhibit plinths. After unloading, reverse along the same line without turning near the exhibits.

title: Blind Picking Aisle Retrieval
description: Take an empty tote forward 9 m into a narrow blind picking aisle on a four-module square body. A picker loads 15.8 kg of small boxed parts at the end rack, then the body reverses all the way to the cross-aisle without turning. Once fully clear, slide right 0.8 m to the takeaway station.

title: Cross Dock Mini Pallet Shuttle
description: Carry an 18 kg combined load of goods and a 0.4 m square mini pallet between two floor-level cross-dock handoff stands. Travel forward 10 m, turn 90 degrees clockwise in a clear intersection, then move 2.4 m diagonally front-left into the receiving lane. Slide right 0.35 m for the final handoff alignment; this job uses no full-size pallets.

title: Dense Hardware Tote Transfer
description: Transfer a 19.6 kg tote of metal fasteners from a low shelf handoff to a packing station 8 m away. The four-module body carries the tote forward along a straight aisle, allowing about 55 seconds for loaded transit. Slide left 0.45 m at the station to place the tote beside the operator without rotating it.

title: Rack Inventory Scanner Sprint
description: Carry a 1.3 kg barcode camera on a two-module body through a 27 m rack aisle during a reserved inventory window. Drive forward past the rack labels in about 108 seconds, then slide left 0.9 m across the clear end bay to the adjacent aisle. Reverse down that aisle while the camera records the opposite rack face.

title: Level Trailer Carton Extraction
description: Enter a stationary trailer through a flush horizontal bridge plate and travel forward 18 m from the indoor receiving point to the loading position. Staff secure a 17 kg carton bundle to the four-module deck, then the body reverses the full route in about 80 seconds. The trailer floor and dock are at equal height, and the straight path requires no turns.

title: Cold Store Offset Dock Approach
description: Carry a 12.2 kg insulated food tote forward 7 m through a cold-storage aisle on a three-module strip body. At the clear aisle end, approach the receiving dock along a 1.2 m front-right diagonal while keeping the tote label facing forward. Allow about 18 seconds for that approach, then retreat diagonally rear-left after unloading.

title: Mezzanine Conveyor Tray Alignment
description: Carry a 9.7 kg parts tray along 5 m of level mezzanine floor to a stopped low conveyor handoff. In the guarded docking pocket, turn three degrees clockwise to square the tray, then slide left 0.12 m over about 10 seconds and creep forward the final 0.18 m over about 12 seconds. Staff transfer the tray once the alignment marks match; the robot stays on this mezzanine throughout.

title: Returned Glassware Inspection Transfer
description: Carry an 8.4 kg divided crate of returned glassware from intake to the inspection bench on a four-module body. Move forward 6 m over about 65 seconds, then travel 1 m diagonally rear-right around a taped exclusion corner without rotating the crate. Slide left 0.25 m into the padded receiving position over about 12 seconds.

title: Mobile Rack Sensor Retrieval
description: Send a two-module body lengthwise into an opened mobile-rack aisle to collect a 6.3 kg sensor tote from a floor-level handoff. Travel forward 4 m through the 0.28 m gap, then slide right 0.025 m to center beneath the handoff guide without turning. After loading, slide left back to the aisle center and reverse out before the rack interlock is released.

title: Pharmacy Tote Diagonal Docking
description: Carry a 10.8 kg sealed medicine tote forward 8 m from picking to the verification cell on a four-module square body. The receiving dock is offset left behind a bench end, so approach along a marked 0.85 m front-left diagonal without changing the tote's heading. Allow about 15 seconds for the diagonal docking movement, then retreat rear-right after the technician removes the tote.

title: Camera Traverse Beside Fallen Partitions
description: Carry a search camera through a cleared, level strip beside fallen corridor partitions using a 2x2 body. Travel forward along the 6 m strip in about 40 seconds, then slide left 0.24 m over 12 seconds to view a void; slide right and reverse along the same route without turning.

title: Office Smoke Survey Circuit
description: Carry a thermal camera and gas sensor from the office entrance to three marked survey positions on a cleared floor. Run forward 8 m in about 40 seconds, slide right 0.8 m in 10 seconds, and cross a 2.4 m diagonal gap toward the front-left in 20 seconds; turn clockwise 90 degrees in 6 seconds in the open copier bay before the final forward leg.

title: Garage Radio Battery Delivery
description: Deliver a spare radio battery to a rescue team across a parking garage using two modules docked end to end. Follow a swept 18 m lane forward in about 70 seconds, then slide left 0.6 m in 10 seconds into the handoff pocket beside a debris pile.

title: Basement Sensor Dock Approach
description: Carry a sealed water-quality sampler over the flat basement slab through a surveyed film of water within the modules' approved operating depth. Move forward 4 m in about 45 seconds, then approach the receiver diagonally front-right along a 1.8 m path in 30 seconds, reducing speed over the final docking markers.

title: Tunnel Air Monitor Shuttle
description: Carry an air monitor from the tunnel staging point to a marked sampling station 55 m down a cleared, level service strip. Drive forward there and reverse back with the sensor facing the same direction, allowing about four minutes for each travel leg and a one-minute sampling stop.

title: Evacuation Alcove Radio Drop
description: Take a small radio to the evacuation marshal at the end of a 7 m hospital storage spur using one module. Enter forward in about 50 seconds, stop for handoff, then reverse the full distance because parked equipment leaves no turning space.

title: Landing Breathing Cylinder Transfer
description: Move an 18 kg breathing-cylinder kit between two crews already stationed on the same broad stairwell landing. With the cylinders strapped horizontally to a 2x2 body, drive forward 3 m in about 35 seconds and slide right 0.5 m in 10 seconds into the receiving zone without turning or approaching the stair edge.

title: Fire Survey Instrument Placement
description: Carry a 24 kg monitoring case on a 2x3 body to a marked instrument position beside a fire-damaged warehouse rack. Travel forward 9 m in about 65 seconds, then slide left 0.18 m over 15 seconds and turn counter-clockwise 6 degrees over 5 seconds to align the case with the survey marks.

title: Carriage Emergency Radio Shuttle
description: Deliver a compact emergency radio from the carriage doorway to responders 16 m along the straight center aisle of a stationary, isolated train. Use two modules docked end to end to clear the seat ends, travel forward in about 64 seconds, and reverse back after handoff without turning.

title: Refuge Chamber Supply Shuttle
description: Move a sealed oxygen-monitor service kit between the refuge chamber entrance and its equipment station 32 m along a straight internal service lane. Keep the three modules in a lengthwise row, drive forward in about 150 seconds, and reverse to the entrance after the kit is removed.

title: Rack Inlet Probe Alignment
description: Carry a short temperature-probe array down a data-centre cold aisle to a rack inlet measurement mark. Move forward 5 m in about 45 seconds, slide left 0.12 m over 12 seconds, and turn clockwise 4 degrees over 4 seconds to square the array; slide right again before reversing out.

title: Inverter Thermal Reference Transfer
description: Carry a fragile calibrated thermal reference from its storage bench to the inspection position beside an isolated inverter cabinet. With the reference cushioned on one module, drive forward 4 m in about 55 seconds and slide right 0.35 m over 10 seconds without rotating the load.

title: Underwing Camera Station Traverse
description: Carry a low inspection camera between two marked stations beneath the wing of a chocked aircraft. Travel diagonally front-left across a clear 12 m path in about 48 seconds, then slide right 0.45 m over 5 seconds to center the camera under the inspection target.

title: Engine Room Analyzer Delivery
description: Carry an 18.6 kg vibration-analyzer package on a 2x2 body along the engine room's continuous flush steel service deck. Drive forward 6 m in about 60 seconds, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 12 seconds in a clear service square, and slide left 0.6 m over 12 seconds beside the measurement station.

title: Turbine Bearing Recess Survey
description: Carry a thermal camera into an 11 m blind service lane ending at a turbine bearing enclosure in the conventional turbine hall. Drive forward in about 70 seconds, slide right 0.25 m over 5 seconds to inspect behind a guard, then slide left and reverse out because the enclosure leaves no turning bay.

title: Pipe Gallery Optical Survey
description: Move a fragile optical alignment instrument through the flat pipe gallery using two modules docked lengthwise. Follow the 8 m straight passage forward in about 95 seconds, then take a 1.2 m front-right diagonal path over 24 seconds into a wider survey recess while keeping the instrument's heading fixed.

title: Blind Walkway Joint Inspection
description: Carry a compact camera along an enclosed, level maintenance walkway beneath the bridge deck to inspect a joint 14 m from the access bay. Drive forward in about 90 seconds, record the joint, and reverse to the bay because the walkway ends at a fixed barrier with no turnaround space.

title: Nacelle Gearbox Camera Alignment
description: Position a low camera fixture beside the gearbox on the nacelle's surveyed flat service floor while the turbine is locked out. Move forward 2.4 m in about 35 seconds, slide right 0.16 m over 20 seconds, and turn counter-clockwise 3 degrees over 6 seconds to match the repeat-photography marks.

title: Cleanroom Particle Counter Traverse
description: Carry a compact particle counter between two sampling marks across a cleared cleanroom bay using a cleaned 2x2 body. Slide left 10 m in about 40 seconds while keeping the sampling inlet facing the tool row, then move forward 0.8 m over 10 seconds into the marked sampling box.

title: Column Scanner Viewpoint Circuit
description: Carry a fragile laser scanner on a low, restrained mount across a closed parking bay using a 2x3 body. Drive forward 5 m in about 60 seconds, slide left 1.2 m over 20 seconds to the second column viewpoint, and turn clockwise 90 degrees over 15 seconds in the marked clear square before recording.

title: Urgent Ward Dressing Delivery
description: Deliver a sealed dressing pack from the supply room to a ward handoff shelf along a reserved 24 m straight corridor. Drive forward in about 94 seconds, then slide right 0.4 m over 8 seconds into the recessed handoff position while keeping clear of the main walking lane.

title: Breakfast Tray Through Service Gap
description: Carry two covered breakfast boxes on a fitted deck across three modules docked in a lengthwise row. Drive forward 9 m in about 80 seconds through a 0.30 m gap beside a parked linen cart, then slide left 0.45 m over 15 seconds into the wider room-door recess; slide right and reverse along the same route after handoff.

title: Baggage Exception Case Transfer
description: Move two compact baggage exception cases totaling 26 kg on a 2x3 body from the inspection desk to the manual collection station. Follow a reserved 65 m straight lane forward in about 280 seconds, then slide right 0.8 m over 10 seconds into the collection pocket without turning.

title: Assembly Cell Kit Replenishment
description: Carry a latched fastener kit from the supermarket rack to an assembly cell using two docked modules. Drive forward 7 m in about 35 seconds, cross a 2.2 m front-right diagonal opening in 15 seconds, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 4 seconds in the clear cell entrance, and slide left 0.3 m over 6 seconds to dock before reversing 0.5 m clear after unloading.

title: Returned Books Sorting Dock
description: Carry a strapped 14 kg stack of returned books from the intake desk to a sorting station on a 2x2 body. Drive forward 6 m in about 50 seconds, then follow a 1.5 m front-left diagonal path into the angled docking marks over 25 seconds, slowing for the last 0.15 m; reverse diagonally rear-right along the same path after unloading.

title: Rush Samples to the Analyzer
description: Carry a latched sample rack from accessioning to the analyzer along a clear vinyl corridor. Drive forward over the 6.5 m transit leg in a 25-second cruise window, then slide right 0.24 m over 8 seconds into the receiving position without turning.

title: Restock the Blind Stockroom Bay
description: Carry a strapped carton of toiletries into a blind backroom aisle using a 2x2 body. Cover the 3.6 m approach in a 24-second cruise window, slide left 0.3 m over 10 seconds for unloading, then slide right and reverse the same aisle in a 30-second cruise window because there is no turning space.

title: Deliver Anchors Behind Temporary Partitions
description: Move a secured box of anchor hardware down a swept, level slab corridor between temporary partitions using a 0.6 m long, 0.4 m wide body. Drive forward along the 5.4 m dead end in a 30-second cruise window, stop for unloading, and reverse out over a 45-second cruise window without turning.

title: Track a Tabletop Camera Shot
description: Carry a low camera cradle with a fragile macro lens across a smooth studio floor on a 2x2 body. Slide left for a 1.8 m tracking shot over 30 seconds, then move diagonally rear-right 0.72 m over 12 seconds to clear the set while keeping the lens pointed at the table. Use gentle acceleration ramps outside the constant-speed shot.

title: Retrieve Gallery Lighting Equipment
description: Carry a padded case of portable gallery lights from an alcove to the after-hours service area using a 0.6 m long, 0.4 m wide body. Reverse 4.2 m out of the blind alcove in a 35-second cruise window, turn clockwise 90 degrees in the open gallery over 6 seconds, and drive forward 3.3 m in a 22-second cruise window.

title: Collect a Narrow Aisle Pick
description: Take a compact picking tote down a 0.46 m aisle on a 2x2 body, leaving only 0.03 m clearance on either side. Drive forward 4.8 m in a 40-second cruise window, then slide left 0.02 m over 4 seconds to meet the shelf transfer guide. Slide right to recenter and reverse out after the pick.

title: Shuttle a Loaded Mini Pallet
description: Carry a 38 kg load on a lightweight 0.75 m by 0.45 m mini pallet supported by an eight-module body arranged four long and two wide. Cross the level cross-dock forward for 7.2 m in a 40-second cruise window, then slide right 0.6 m over 12 seconds into a marked unloading pocket without rotating the pallet.

title: Align Tote With Transfer Fingers
description: Bring a tote from a shelf pickup point to a packing station using a 2x2 body. Drive forward 2.8 m in a 20-second cruise window, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 10 seconds in the station apron, and slide left through the final 0.12 m over 12 seconds to align the tote with transfer fingers.

title: Scan Two Rack Faces
description: Carry a short barcode scanner mast along two parallel rack faces using a two-module body. Drive forward along each 10.4 m scan leg in a 40-second cruise window, using strobed barcode capture while moving. At the wide aisle end, turn clockwise 180 degrees over 4 seconds and slide right 0.9 m over 6 seconds to enter the return scan lane.

title: Unload Lightweight Trailer Cartons
description: Carry a secured bundle of empty display cartons from a trailer to the receiving bench on a 2x2 body. Drive forward 8.1 m in a 30-second cruise window across a flush, locked dock bridge, then go diagonally front-left 1.3 m over 10 seconds to the bench. Reverse over the same diagonal and straight route after unloading.

title: Run Samples Through Cold Storage
description: Carry a sealed food-quality sample box from the cold-room entrance to a technician at the far end of a straight aisle. Drive forward along the 15.6 m aisle in a 60-second cruise window, then reverse the same route after handoff because the end has no turning apron.

title: Feed the Mezzanine Conveyor
description: Carry a tote from a staging pad to a conveyor on the same level mezzanine using a 2x2 body. Drive forward 3.8 m in a 20-second cruise window, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 5 seconds in a guarded apron, and move diagonally front-right 0.96 m over 8 seconds around a column. Slide left 0.18 m over 9 seconds for handoff, then reverse 0.4 m over 5 seconds to clear the conveyor.

title: Collect Returns From Sorting Nook
description: Carry a tray of returned handheld scanners out of a blind sorting nook with a two-module body oriented lengthwise. Reverse 2.7 m in an 18-second cruise window, slide right 0.56 m over 8 seconds across the open mouth, and drive forward 2.2 m in an 11-second cruise window to the testing desk.

title: Reorient Between Mobile Rack Bays
description: Carry a small RFID reader through three inspection positions in an open mobile-rack aisle using a two-module body. Advance 1.44 m between positions in 8-second cruise windows, then turn in place 90 degrees over 2 seconds to face each rack and turn back before continuing. Finish with a 0.32 m left slide over 4 seconds onto the return marker.

title: Route Prescriptions Through Verification
description: Carry a locked prescription tray between dispensing and verification on a two-module body. Drive forward 2.3 m in a 10-second cruise window, move diagonally front-left 0.84 m over 7 seconds through the open cell center, and turn clockwise 90 degrees over 6 seconds at verification. Slide right 0.08 m over 8 seconds into the tray guide, then reverse 0.3 m over 5 seconds after handoff.

description: Carry a low thermal camera through a cleared strip between fallen wall panels on a 2x2 body. At a surveyed wider pocket, slide left 0.06 m over 6 seconds to look behind a panel, slide back, and reverse to the entry team.

description: Carry a sealed two-way radio to a marked responder position on a surveyed, cool office floor using a two-module body. Go diagonally front-left 0.9 m over 10 seconds to the handoff marker and reverse 0.4 m over 5 seconds to leave room.

description: Carry a medical supply box to a marked transfer dock beside a garage search team using a two-module body. Keep the box facing forward and reverse diagonally rear-left after the handoff.

description: Carry a waterproof radio case across a flat basement floor with a surveyed 3 mm film of water, using a module approved for that water depth. Reverse diagonally rear-right after collection without turning near the pump hose.

description: Carry a compact evacuation supply kit to a nurse's transfer marker beside a bed staging area using a two-module body. Keep the kit facing the nurse and withdraw diagonally rear-left after unloading.

The aisle has been swept after the fire and has no hot spots or standing water.

Drive forward 4.8 m in a 40-second cruise window, slide left 0.24 m over 6 seconds into an open wheelchair bay, and turn clockwise 90 degrees over 5 seconds inside the bay. Move diagonally front-right 0.56 m over 8 seconds to the responder's marker, then reverse 0.3 m over 5 seconds after handoff.

description: Carry a low crate of drinking-water pouches and radio batteries from inside the refuge chamber entrance to its supply bench on a 2x2 body. At the wider bench recess, slide right 0.15 m over 10 seconds for unloading, slide left to recenter, and reverse out without turning.

title: Cold Aisle Sensor Docking
description: Carry a temperature logger on a four-module square body along the 9 m cold aisle in 45 seconds. At the aisle end, approach the charging contact diagonally front-left over 0.6 m in 12 seconds, keeping the sensor facing the racks.

title: Turbine Pedestal Clearance Survey
description: Carry a vibration data receiver on a four-module square body through a 0.48 m gap beside a turbine pedestal, advancing 3.6 m in 30 seconds. At the wider inspection pocket, slide left 0.12 m in 8 seconds to reach the reading position, then slide right before reversing out.

description: Carry a 28 kg ultrasonic inspection pack on six modules arranged two wide and three long through the enclosed pipe gallery. Travel 12 m forward in 80 seconds, then slide left 0.6 m in 15 seconds into a wider work recess where a technician unloads the pack.

title: Underside Walkway Optical Survey
description: Carry a padded optical survey head along a level, enclosed maintenance walkway beneath the bridge deck. Advance 6.3 m in 90 seconds, then slide right 0.18 m in 12 seconds beneath the survey window while keeping the fragile instrument facing forward.

title: Nacelle Sensor Shuttle
description: Carry a small thermal sensor on a two-module body along the cleared 5.2 m service strip inside a shut-down nacelle, reaching the gearbox station in 20 seconds. After recording, reverse along the same strip at the same transit speed because the cable channel prevents turning.

title: Cleanroom Particle Sampling Circuit
description: Carry a particle counter on six modules through the cleanroom bay, advancing 8.4 m in 60 seconds and sliding left 0.4 m in 10 seconds to sample beside a tool. title: Column Base Crack Imaging
description: Carry a low crack camera on two modules arranged fore-and-aft through a 0.3 m gap between a parking column and a protective rail. Advance and reverse over the same 2.4 m strip in 30 seconds each way, sliding left and right by 0.02 m in 4 seconds at the imaging marks.

title: Ward Supply Cabinet Circuit
description: Deliver sealed dressing packs to three ward supply cabinets on a two-module body, covering each 4.8 m corridor leg in 30 seconds. Turn in place 90 degrees in 3 seconds at the clear junctions, using clockwise and counter-clockwise turns to present the tray handle to staff.

title: Guest Room Breakfast Delivery
description: Carry a covered breakfast tray on one module along a straight 22 m hotel corridor in 110 seconds. At the room's recessed doorway, slide right 0.3 m in 10 seconds so the tray can be lifted without blocking the corridor.

title: Baggage Tag Stock Express
description: Carry replacement baggage-tag rolls between two staffed desks across a closed service lane in the baggage hall. Drive forward 19.5 m in 75 seconds, then cross the open desk apron diagonally front-left over 2.4 m in 10 seconds to reach the receiving shelf.

title: Ceramic Kit Line Delivery
description: Carry a foam-lined tray of ceramic sensor housings on a four-module square body from inspection to the assembly line, covering 7.2 m in 90 seconds. Slide left 0.24 m in 12 seconds beneath the receiving shelf, then slide right after unloading and reverse along the same lane.

title: Returned Books Sorting Circuit
description: Carry a shallow bin of returned books on four modules between three sorting desks, covering each 3.6 m leg in 24 seconds. Turn in place 180 degrees in 5 seconds at the first desk and 90 degrees in 2.5 seconds in the opposite direction at the next, so the bin opening faces each librarian.

title: Sample Rack Analyzer Transfer
description: Carry a capped sample rack on one module, moving forward 3.6 m in 30 seconds and diagonally front-right 0.6 m in 10 seconds around a fixed bench corner. title: Backroom Cosmetics Restock
description: Carry a tote of boxed cosmetics on two modules through a backroom route with four alternating right-angle bends. description: Move a survey scanner and battery pack among four cleared pads around a parking-garage debris field without crossing rubble. description: Deliver a lightweight water-level logger along a straight 22 m basement service aisle with a uniform 4 mm film of clean water on the flat floor. Cruise forward along the flush 5.4 m aisle section in 45 seconds, slide left 0.24 m over 8 seconds inside the vestibule, and reverse 0.36 m over 6 seconds to place the cradle under the table lift.

title: Refuge Chamber Filter Shuttle
description: Move replacement scrubber cartridges from the storage end of a mine refuge chamber to its service hatch along a straight 28 m finished-floor lane. Arrange the three modules in line, cruise forward through the central 19.2 m in 80 seconds, and reverse empty after the cartridges are removed because the hatch recess has no turning space.

title: Cold Aisle Sensor Dock
description: Carry a compact temperature logger through a data-centre cold aisle, cruising forward along a 4.2 m rack section in 20 seconds. At the aisle end, move diagonally front-left 0.45 m over 9 seconds to meet the charging contacts without changing heading, then withdraw diagonally rear-right over the same path.

title: Inverter Cabinet Narrow Scan
description: Carry a thermal camera and recorder through the 0.3 m service gap behind inverter cabinets, using three modules in a straight line. Cruise forward along the clear 3.6 m section in 30 seconds, slide right 0.04 m over 4 seconds to establish the camera standoff at a recessed panel, then slide left and reverse out without turning.

description: Move a small diagnostic logger between the rear service station and gearbox work position inside a parked wind-turbine nacelle. description: Carry a low particle counter between three sampling points in a semiconductor cleanroom bay, using three modules in line and cruising forward over 3.6 m sections in 20 seconds. Cruise forward 2.7 m to the first mark in 18 seconds, slide left 0.6 m over 12 seconds across its face, turn clockwise 90 degrees over 10 seconds at the clear corner, then advance to the next face and slide right at the same scan speed.

title: Sterile Packs Through Ward Stores
description: Carry a secured 24 kg tote of sterile packs from the hospital supply lift to the ward store using a 2x3 body. Travel forward along the 12 m corridor at a pace covering each clear 3 m section in 15 seconds, then slide right through a 0.46 m gap without changing heading. The final 0.30 m sideways insertion takes 10 seconds because the tote passes close to a cabinet handle.

title: Breakfast Tray Alcove Delivery

description: Move one strapped cabin bag from the airport exception belt to the manual inspection table. Drive forward along an 8 m fenced lane, covering clear 2.6 m sections in 10 seconds, then turn clockwise 90 degrees in five seconds inside the marked turning box. Cross the open apron diagonally front-left for 1.2 m in six seconds, slide left 0.36 m in six seconds to the table, and reverse 0.5 m after unloading.

title: Connector Kit Fixture Alignment
description: Carry a 16 kg connector kit on a 2x2 body from the supermarket rack to a line-side fixture 4 m ahead. Cover clear 1.4 m sections in 10 seconds, then slide left 0.12 m over eight seconds to align the tote with the fixture guides. Correct a clockwise heading error of up to four degrees over four seconds before the operator lifts the kit.

title: Reserved Books Express Return
description: Carry three reserved books from the return desk to the sorting assistant at the far end of a closed library service aisle. The single module has an unobstructed 18 m straight run and must cover each clear 5.2 m section in 20 seconds. Keep the same heading throughout and stop at the taped handoff square.

title: Culture Rack Bench Transfer
description: Move a sealed transport carrier containing glass culture tubes between two laboratory benches using a 2x2 body. Advance 5 m along the bench aisle, covering clear 1.1 m sections in 10 seconds with gentle starts and stops. Slide right 0.45 m over 15 seconds into the receiving recess while keeping the carrier facing the same direction.

title: Cosmetics Tote Shelf Handoff
description: Bring a compact cosmetics tote from the backroom packing table to a low shelf handoff bay 3 m away. Run forward at a pace of 0.8 m per five seconds, then slide right or left to center the tote between the bay markers. Allow six seconds for a 60 mm lateral correction and ten seconds to reverse 0.4 m after staff take the tote.

title: Glazed Tile Sample Delivery
description: Carry a cushioned case of glazed tile samples across a swept indoor construction slab to the finish-selection table. Travel forward for 6 m, covering uninterrupted 0.9 m sections in 10 seconds, then move diagonally front-right through a clear 1 m opening in 20 seconds. Keep the case orientation fixed so its padded dividers remain aligned with the travel plan.

title: Low Camera Tracking Take
description: Carry a secured compact cinema camera on a low isolation mount across the studio stage. During the take, slide left along a 2.4 m track in 30 seconds without yaw, then reverse the slide to reset at the same pace. Between takes, move diagonally rear-right 0.6 m in 15 seconds to clear the actor's walking line.

title: Gallery Label Stock Delivery
description: Take a secured box of replacement labels and mounting supplies to the museum installation crew after closing. Advance 7 m along the gallery wall, covering clear 1.7 m sections in 10 seconds, then slide left through a 0.46 m opening between plinths with the 2x2 body held square. The 0.6 m sideways passage takes 20 seconds, and the body slides right along the same path after unloading.

title: Offset Pick Tote Docking
description: Carry a small picked-parts tote down a 9 m rack aisle to a dock offset left inside the widened end bay. Cover clear 2.2 m aisle sections in 10 seconds, then move diagonally front-left along the marked 0.84 m docking line in 12 seconds without rotating. After the tote is removed, withdraw diagonally rear-right along that line.

title: Instrument Mini Pallet Shuttle
description: Shuttle a 0.55 by 0.35 m mini pallet carrying boxed optical instruments between two cross-dock inspection benches. The pallet and instruments weigh 23 kg together and fit on the 2x3 body. Drive forward across the 16 m cleared lane, covering clear 1.6 m sections in 10 seconds, then slide right 0.48 m in eight seconds to the receiving bench without turning the fragile load.

title: Tote Through Guarded Station
description: Transfer a 14 kg tote from the low rack pickup point to a packing station using a 2x2 body. title: Pharmacy Cell Side Entry

Keep the 0.60 m body axis along the sideways path and take 20 seconds for the final 0.50 m insertion.

title: Camera Alignment At Corridor Breach

Return forward along the same corridor, slowing at the responder handoff point.

Retreat diagonally rear-right through the opening and reverse along the straight lane; the body never crosses loose debris or a ramp.

title: Basement Water Gauge Placement

description: Carry dressings and evacuation labels from the nurses' station to a staffed holding area along a cleared hospital corridor. Reverse 1 m in 10 seconds after staff unload the tray.

Reverse to the staging mark after unloading; the route never enters the stairs.

description: Deliver sealed sampling kits to four investigators working in a warehouse cleared for entry after a fire. Follow four 5 m straight legs in about 30 seconds each and turn in place at the marked junction pads, using three clockwise quarter-turns and one counter-clockwise quarter-turn. Each turn takes about 3 seconds so the tray handle faces the investigator before handoff.

title: Dock Supplies Inside Evacuation Carriage
description: Move a strapped emergency supply chest from the vestibule to a responder's transfer shelf inside a stationary train carriage. The six-module body follows 9 m of cleared aisle in about 65 seconds, then approaches the recessed shelf diagonally front-left along a 0.85 m path in 18 seconds without turning. After unloading, withdraw diagonally rear-right along the same path.

title: Resupply Refuge Chamber Benches
description: Carry sealed drinking-water pouches from the refuge chamber cache to the far occupied bench in a chamber cleared for robot use. Travel forward 4 m in 35 seconds, slide left 0.7 m in 12 seconds around a fixed table, and turn clockwise 90 degrees in 9 seconds to present the tray. Reverse 0.8 m in 12 seconds after handoff.

title: Align Cold Aisle Sensor Dock
description: Carry a temperature and airflow logger down 14 m of cold aisle in about 80 seconds to a floor-level calibration dock beside the final rack. Keep the four-module square facing down the aisle and approach the dock diagonally front-right over 0.64 m in 16 seconds. Withdraw diagonally rear-left after the calibration dwell.

title: Rush Inverter Thermal Check
description: Carry a compact thermal logger from the indoor service desk to an inverter cabinet before a scheduled load test ends. Cover the clear 18 m service lane in about 70 seconds, then slide right 0.5 m in 8 seconds to the marked measurement position. Hold there for the reading without turning.

title: Survey Beneath Aircraft Wing
description: Carry an upward-facing camera under a parked aircraft wing to photograph three marked inspection points. Move forward 6 m in 40 seconds, slide left 1.2 m in 15 seconds beside a wheel exclusion zone, then travel diagonally front-right 2 m in 20 seconds to the final mark. Turn counter-clockwise 45 degrees in 6 seconds there to frame the last image.

title: Inspect Engine Room Blind Bays
description: Carry a vibration recorder into two blind service bays on a stationary ship's level engine-room deck. Enter each 3.6 m bay in about 30 seconds, stop beside the bearing housing for a reading, and reverse the full distance in about 40 seconds because the six-module body cannot turn inside. At the open junction, turn clockwise 90 degrees in 7 seconds before entering the second bay.

title: Traverse Turbine Hall Survey Line
description: Carry a compact acoustic logger along a 48 m marked line beside the turbine enclosure in about 190 seconds. Keep the same heading and return in reverse along the line in about 220 seconds after the end-point recording. The route stays in the accessible turbine hall and does not pass through controlled radiation areas.

title: Survey Pipe Gallery Leak Marks
description: Carry a humidity probe and camera between three marked pipe joints in an enclosed gallery. Advance 7 m in 55 seconds, slide right 0.8 m in 16 seconds through the space between support feet, and move diagonally rear-left 0.9 m in 15 seconds to view a joint behind a brace. Turn clockwise 60 degrees in 8 seconds at the widened inspection pocket.

title: Reverse From Bridge Inspection Spur
description: Carry an upward-looking camera rig along the enclosed, level maintenance walkway beneath the bridge deck. Enter a 10 m blind spur in about 80 seconds, record the end bearing, and reverse out in about 100 seconds because the six-module body has no turning space. The entire route stays inside the covered walkway on flush steel plates.

title: Record Nacelle Service Lane
description: Carry a low thermal camera along the 8.4 m straight service lane inside a stopped wind-turbine nacelle. Complete the forward imaging pass in about 55 seconds and reverse to the access staging mark in about 65 seconds without turning beside the machinery. The modules are placed on the nacelle's level floor before the job starts.

title: Position Cleanroom Metrology Fixture
description: Move a heavy enclosed metrology fixture from its storage stand to a floor-level inspection station in the cleanroom bay. Carry it forward 11 m in about 90 seconds, then slide left 0.32 m in 16 seconds to align its optical window with the station target. Keep the four-module square at the same heading throughout and wait while the technician records the measurement.

title: Reposition Column Scanning Rig
description: Carry a compact laser scanner and its heavy calibration base between two columns on one level of an enclosed parking structure. Cross the closed 16 m traffic lane in about 100 seconds, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees in 10 seconds within a marked clear square, then slide right 1.1 m in 22 seconds to establish the second scan position. Stop fully before each scan.

title: Deliver Ward Fluid Cartons
description: Carry two secured cartons of infusion fluids from the ward store to the treatment-room receiving mark. Cover a 24 m straight corridor in about 140 seconds, turn clockwise 90 degrees in 8 seconds at a widened junction, and slide left 0.6 m in 15 seconds beside the receiving bench. Staff lift the cartons off before the body reverses 1.2 m in 15 seconds.

title: Place Breakfast Tray At Suite
description: Carry a covered breakfast tray along 15 m of hotel corridor in about 110 seconds. Turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees in 10 seconds at the suite alcove, then approach the waiting attendant diagonally front-right over 0.75 m in 15 seconds. Once the tray is removed, slide left 0.5 m in 10 seconds to clear the door swing and reverse 1 m in 12 seconds.

title: Collect Baggage Scanner Consumables
description: Carry a sealed box of scanner cleaning supplies into the blind service lane behind a baggage inspection station. Travel forward 6.5 m in about 35 seconds, wait for the technician to remove the box, then reverse the same distance in about 45 seconds. Maintain the original heading because belt supports leave no turning space.

title: Deliver Fragile Ceramic Kit
description: Carry a foam-lined kit of ceramic sensor housings from the kitting rack to an assembly operator. Travel 8 m forward in about 100 seconds, then slide right 0.4 m in 20 seconds to place the tray beside the operator's fixture without rotating it. Pause for unloading and reverse 0.8 m in 16 seconds with gentle starts and stops.

title: Shuttle Returned Books To Sorting
description: Carry a clipped bin of returned paperbacks from the indoor return desk to the sorting station at the far end of a straight 30 m staff aisle. Complete the loaded run in about 120 seconds, wait while the sorter exchanges the bin, and reverse along the same aisle in about 135 seconds. Both stations accept the bin at the same body heading.

title: Present Samples At Laboratory Stations
description: Carry a sealed sample carrier between four laboratory receiving stands connected by 3 m straight lanes. Cover each of the three lanes in about 25 seconds and turn in place at every receiving stand to present the carrier latch, alternating clockwise and counter-clockwise quarter-turns. Allow about 7 seconds for each turn so the tubes remain settled in their inserts.

title: Restock Blind Backroom Shelf
description: Carry a shallow crate of bottled toiletries into a blind backroom aisle where a stocker is replenishing the lowest shelf. Enter the 4.8 m aisle in about 30 seconds, slide left 0.18 m in 9 seconds for handoff, then slide right to the aisle centre after unloading. Reverse out in about 40 seconds because the shelf ends prevent a turn.

title: Carry Glazed Tile Test Panels
description: Move a padded crate of glazed tile test panels across a swept indoor slab to the finishing contractor's bench. Travel forward 9 m in about 120 seconds, then go diagonally front-left along a 1.4 m clear path in 28 seconds between two material stacks. Slide right 0.25 m in 12 seconds for unloading while keeping the crate at the same heading.

title: Move Low Camera Through Set
description: Carry a compact remotely operated camera through a floor-level product shot on an indoor soundstage. Track forward 3 m in 30 seconds, slide left 0.8 m in 16 seconds, then move diagonally rear-right 1.2 m in 20 seconds while keeping the lens trained using its gimbal. Finish with a clockwise 30-degree body turn in 10 seconds and reverse 1 m in 15 seconds to the reset mark.

title: Deliver Gallery Label Supplies
description: Carry a secured case of replacement labels and mounting tools from the preparation room to a curator at the far end of a 36 m straight gallery route after closing. Complete the outward run in about 155 seconds, pause for the case exchange, then reverse along the same route in about 180 seconds. Stay between the marked exhibit setbacks without turning near display plinths.

title: Alternating Rack Face Picks
description: Carry a 12 kg picking tray on three modules docked in a line through a 0.74 m aisle. Cruise along each 2.4 m rack section in 15 seconds, then turn in place through 180 degrees to present the tray to the opposite rack, allowing six seconds per turn plus settling. Repeat at three marked picking positions before reversing into the collection pocket.

title: Mini Pallet Cross Dock Shuttle
description: Move a 32 kg mini pallet of fittings between cross-dock sorting islands on an eight-module body arranged 0.8 m by 0.4 m. The route has three 4.8 m straight sections cruised in 20 seconds each, with a turn in place at each junction to keep the pallet label facing the receiving lane. Alternate clockwise and counter-clockwise quarter-turns, allowing three seconds of rotation plus settling at each island.

title: Tote Placement At Packing Nest
description: Carry a 17 kg tote from a shelf pickup point to a packing nest on a square four-module body. Cruise forward along the 3.6 m approach in 24 seconds, then slide right through a 0.12 m final offset over eight seconds while keeping the tote parallel to the nest. Reverse straight out after the operator removes the tote; the nest requires placement within 5 mm.

title: Rack Scan And Offset Dock
description: Carry a 4 kg barcode camera assembly along an 8.4 m rack face on a square four-module body, cruising at a pace that covers the scan length in 60 seconds. At the rack end, approach the charging target diagonally front-left along a marked 0.75 m segment over ten seconds without changing camera heading. The scan lane opens into a clear docking apron.

title: Trailer Tool Case Unload
description: Carry a secured 28 kg tool case from inside a parked trailer to an indoor receiving stand on a six-module rectangular body. The trailer floor and dock are flush across a secured level bridge plate; cruise forward along the 9.6 m route in 80 seconds. At the receiving stand, slide left by 0.48 m over eight seconds and reverse along the same route after unloading.

title: Cold Room Sample Circuit
description: Deliver a 9 kg insulated sample box to four cold-room checking points on a square four-module body. Cruise along 2.1 m aisle sections in 15 seconds and turn in place at the widened rack ends to face each checking point. Each clockwise or counter-clockwise quarter-turn has three seconds of rotation followed by a stationary temperature reading.

title: Mezzanine Conveyor Side Feed
description: Move a 14 kg carton tray along a level mezzanine already occupied by the robot; no stair or lift travel is part of this job. A square four-module body cruises forward through a 0.46 m guide passage for 2.8 m in 20 seconds, then slides right along a 0.42 m crosswise guide over 14 seconds to the conveyor feed position. Slide left back to the passage and reverse out after the tray is lifted.

title: Dense Returns Bin Transfer
description: Carry a 9.4 kg bin of returned metal fittings on a two-module body from the weighing bench to the inspection table. Cruise forward along the 4.4 m lane in 40 seconds, then slide left by 0.36 m over six seconds into the table-side unloading pocket. Keep the bin facing the operator and reverse out after unloading.

title: Mobile Rack Endcap Delivery
description: Take a 16 kg replenishment tote down a locked-open mobile-rack aisle on a square four-module body. The straight cruise section is 24.3 m and must be covered in 90 seconds before slowing at the endcap handoff mark. Reverse the full aisle after unloading because the endcap has no turning space.

title: Pharmacy Verification Tray Loop
description: Carry a 3 kg tray of sealed prescriptions from a dispenser to a verification station on a two-module body. Cruise forward 2.4 m in 12 seconds, turn clockwise in place through 90 degrees over three seconds, and go diagonally front-right along a 0.6 m marked approach over five seconds. Slide left 0.1 m over five seconds for scanner alignment, then reverse away after verification.

title: Corridor Search Relay Placement
description: Carry a 1.6 kg camera and radio relay on one module through a cleared strip of flat floor beside a collapsed corridor partition. Cruise forward along the 4.2 m strip in 30 seconds, then move diagonally front-left along a 0.56 m marked path over eight seconds to dock against a responder's relay cradle. Keep the camera pointed down the corridor throughout the approach.

title: Office Respirator Cache Delivery
description: Rush a 4 kg respirator supply pouch to a responder staging point across a smoke-filled office floor on a six-module rectangular body. A surveyed 16.2 m corridor cruise section has a 60-second target, and the final 2.4 m open-floor approach runs diagonally front-right over ten seconds. Hold heading through both legs and stop at the staging mat for manual unloading.

title: Garage Search Camera Traverse
description: Carry a 3.2 kg search camera and work light along a cleared parking-garage lane using three modules docked in a line. The flat 21.6 m cruise section between debris piles is traversed in 90 seconds, with stationary camera checks at both ends. Reverse along the same lane because the far end is blocked by a fallen barrier.

title: Basement Water Sensor Docking
description: Carry a 6 kg water-quality sampling kit to a wall-side sampling cradle on a square four-module body through a basement with 5 mm of standing water. Cruise forward along the 3 m cleared route in 50 seconds, then approach diagonally rear-right along a 0.45 m marked segment over 15 seconds to seat the kit beside the cradle. Keep the sample ports facing the wall and stop for a manual sample transfer.

title: Tunnel Wall Gap Survey
description: Carry a 4.5 kg crack-imaging unit through a cleared service-tunnel strip on three modules docked in a line, with the 0.2 m body width facing a 0.29 m gap. Cruise forward 6.3 m in 70 seconds, then slide right 0.04 m over four seconds to position the lens beside a wall crack. Slide left to recenter and reverse out without turning.

title: Evacuation Radio Battery Run
description: Deliver a 2.8 kg pack of radio batteries and patient identification bands to an evacuation desk on a square four-module body. Cruise forward through an attendant-cleared 18.9 m hospital corridor section in 70 seconds, then slide left 0.6 m over five seconds into the desk recess. Slide right out of the recess and reverse to the supply point after unloading.

title: Landing Communication Cradle Approach
description: Move a 1.2 kg communication repeater from the fire door to a wall cradle entirely within one flat stairwell landing using a single module. Advance 1.2 m at a ten-second cruise pace, then go diagonally front-right along a 0.48 m approach over eight seconds to the cradle. The route stays behind a temporary barrier separating the working area from the stair opening.

title: Fire Evidence Vial Transfer
description: Carry a 3.6 kg padded rack of sealed glass evidence vials from a cooled warehouse sampling point to the investigation bench on two modules. Cruise forward along a swept 4.8 m path in 60 seconds, turn counter-clockwise in place through 90 degrees over ten seconds in a clear square, and slide right 0.24 m over eight seconds beside the bench. Use gentle starts and stops to keep the fragile vials upright.

title: Carriage Emergency Supply Traverse
description: Carry an 8 kg bag of dressings and drinking water down a stationary train carriage on a square four-module body. Cruise forward along the 14.4 m straight aisle section in 60 seconds to a responder beside the far vestibule, then reverse back after unloading. The body stays inside this carriage and passes through no inter-car connection.

title: Refuge Alcove Sensor Retrieval
description: Retrieve a 7 kg removable air-monitoring cartridge from a blind equipment alcove in a mine refuge chamber using three modules docked in a line. Enter forward along the 3.6 m narrow alcove at a 30-second cruise pace and wait while a responder secures the cartridge. Reverse out at a slower 45-second cruise pace because rear visibility is restricted, with no room to turn.

title: Cold Aisle Thermal Survey
description: Carry a 2.4 kg thermal camera and airflow probe along a data-centre cold aisle on two modules. Cruise forward along 7.2 m of cabinet fronts in 60 seconds, then approach the calibration dock diagonally rear-left along a 0.63 m marked segment over nine seconds in the aisle-end apron. Keep the camera facing the cabinets until the calibration hood encloses it.

title: Inverter Cabinet Side Traverse
description: Carry a 12 kg electrical inspection instrument on a six-module body arranged 0.6 m long by 0.4 m wide inside an inverter room. Cruise forward along the 4 m cabinet passage in 40 seconds, then slide left 1.05 m over 35 seconds through a crosswise passage only 0.68 m wide in the body's long dimension. Stop at three cabinet windows during that lateral traverse, then slide right and reverse to the doorway.

title: Underwing Camera Position Sprint
description: Carry a 1.8 kg upward-facing camera under a parked aircraft wing on a two-module body. Cruise forward across a clear 10.8 m hangar lane in 40 seconds, then travel diagonally front-left along a 2.6 m marked segment in ten seconds to the inspection position. After imaging, move diagonally rear-right along the same segment and reverse to the equipment cart.

title: Engine Room Gauge Alignment
description: Carry a 5 kg optical gauge reader along a flat engine-room deck on three modules docked in a line while the ship is moored. Cruise forward along 2.7 m of clear deck in 30 seconds, then turn clockwise in place through 12 degrees over six seconds in a widened inspection bay. Slide left 0.045 m over nine seconds to center the reader on a gauge window within 3 mm, then reverse away after the reading.

title: Turbine Hall Survey Circuit
description: Carry a 4 kg vibration and thermal survey package between marked inspection positions in a turbine hall on two modules. Cruise forward along a 6.6 m lane in 30 seconds, turn counter-clockwise in place through 90 degrees over two seconds in a clear bay, then travel diagonally front-right 1.1 m over ten seconds toward a bearing pedestal. Slide right 0.18 m over six seconds to align with a viewing window, take a stationary reading, and reverse 1.2 m at a ten-second pace to clear the pedestal.

title: Pipe Gallery Thermal Survey
description: Carry a thermal camera and logger on a four-module square body through the level pipe gallery. Travel forward along a 9 m service lane in about 50 seconds, slide left 0.6 m beneath a valve bank in 10 seconds, and reverse out after recording. At the widened junction, turn clockwise 90 degrees in 6 seconds and go diagonally front-right 1.2 m in 10 seconds to the final inspection mark.

title: Underdeck Optical Reference Delivery
description: Carry a padded optical reference assembly along an enclosed, level maintenance walkway beneath the bridge deck. The two-module body travels forward 7.2 m in about 95 seconds, then slides right 0.24 m in 12 seconds to an inspector's pickup mark. Keep its heading fixed between the handrail and instrument cases to avoid disturbing the glass assembly.

title: Nacelle Cable Pocket Inspection
description: With the turbine stopped and secured, send one module carrying a low camera into a level cable-service pocket on the nacelle floor. Drive forward 1.8 m in about 24 seconds, pause to inspect the cable glands, and reverse the same distance in about 30 seconds. The 0.28 m passage ends at a bulkhead and has no turning space.

title: Cleanroom Tool Gap Survey
description: Carry a compact particle counter through a 0.25 m clear gap between two tool enclosures using a cleanroom-qualified single module. Keep the sensor facing the tool and slide left 2.4 m in about 65 seconds, stopping at three sampling marks. Slide right along the same path to return; there is no room to yaw.

title: Column Recess Crack Scan
description: Carry a crack-imaging camera on a fore-and-aft pair through a closed parking inspection zone. Drive forward 3.6 m into a 0.34 m gap between a column and a protective barrier in about 36 seconds, scan, and reverse out without turning. In the open staging square, turn counter-clockwise 180 degrees in about 9 seconds to face the next column.

title: Ward Dressing Pack Delivery
description: Move a sealed dressing-pack tote from the supply room to a ward receiving shelf on a two-module body. Cover the 18 m cleared corridor in about 80 seconds, turn clockwise 90 degrees in 4 seconds at the junction, and cross the vestibule diagonally front-left for 2.1 m in 14 seconds. Slide right 0.36 m in 9 seconds beneath the receiving shelf, then reverse 0.8 m after staff remove the tote.

title: Room Service Tray Handoff
description: Carry a restrained breakfast tray on three modules arranged in a line along the hotel corridor. Travel forward 6 m in about 55 seconds and stop alongside the room's service table without turning. Slide left 0.3 m in about 18 seconds, making the last 30 mm at 0.006 m/s so the tray edge aligns with the table.

title: Baggage Tag Stock Express
description: Carry a carton of baggage-tag rolls on a three-module line body from the stock cage to the printer island. The segregated service lane is straight for 42 m and the moving portion of the run should take about 165 seconds. Keep heading fixed, drive forward throughout, and slow for the marked receiving box.

title: Ceramic Insulator Kit Transfer
description: Carry a padded tray of ceramic insulators on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body from inspection to the assembly fixture. Move forward along the 8 m line-side lane in about 100 seconds, then slide right 0.5 m in 16 seconds into the handoff space. Keep the tray heading unchanged and avoid abrupt corrections beside the fixture.

title: Returned Hardback Bin Haul
description: Move a low bin of returned hardbacks on a six-module rectangular body from the sorting desk to the shelving station. Drive forward 12 m in about 90 seconds, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees in 8 seconds within the clear end bay, and reverse 1.2 m into the unloading position in about 20 seconds. The book bin fits entirely within the deck and is secured against sliding.

title: Chilled Sample Carrier Transfer
description: Carry a compact chilled carrier containing sealed sample racks on a four-module square body between laboratory receiving and the cold-room handoff. Go diagonally front-right across the clear 4.8 m staging area in about 40 seconds, then drive forward 5.4 m through the instrument aisle in 45 seconds. Slide left 0.28 m in 14 seconds to place the carrier beside the technician's bench.

title: Backroom Toiletry Carton Run
description: Move a strapped carton of toiletries on a four-module square body from the receiving bench to the sales-floor staging door. The backroom has a clear 30 m straight lane, with about 120 seconds allocated to travel. Drive forward to the marked stop and reverse the same route after staff unload the carton.

title: Survey Target Base Placement
description: Carry a weighted survey-target base across a swept, level indoor slab on a four-module square body. Travel forward 4 m in about 40 seconds, turn clockwise 12 degrees in 6 seconds, and slide right 0.18 m in about 15 seconds to align the base with a chalk cross. Make the final 20 mm of the slide at 0.004 m/s before the surveyor lifts the base onto the mark.

title: Straight Studio Tracking Take
description: Carry a compact remotely operated camera on a low mount across the level studio floor using a six-module rectangular body. Start from a run-up mark, track forward for 10.8 m at 0.18 m/s during a 60-second take, then decelerate in the run-out area. Reverse to the start after the take without changing the camera heading.

title: Gallery Label Proof Express
description: Carry a small envelope of replacement label proofs on one module from the curator's desk to the installation team after closing. Cross the clear gallery diagonally front-left for 7.5 m in about 30 seconds, then drive forward 3 m through the display gap in about 15 seconds. Stop at the staff pickup mark clear of the display plinths.

title: Narrow Pick Slot Retrieval
description: Send one module with an empty small-parts tray forward 5 m through a 0.27 m clear picking lane in about 65 seconds. At the marked opening, slide left 0.16 m in 10 seconds so a picker can load the tray. Slide right back into the lane and reverse to the collection station without turning.

title: Mini Pallet Shuttle Docking
description: Carry a lightweight 0.36 by 0.18 m sample pallet on a fore-and-aft two-module body across the cross-dock to a low receiving fixture. Drive forward 6 m in about 42 seconds, then slide right 0.22 m in about 16 seconds while keeping the pallet parallel to the fixture. Complete the last 20 mm at 0.005 m/s so the pallet's locating tabs line up for manual transfer.

title: Four Bay Tote Circuit
description: Carry a small tote on one module around four shelf-end handoff bays before reaching the packing station. Each bay requires a counter-clockwise 90-degree turn in place in about 2.5 seconds so the tote opening faces the operator, followed by a forward 2 m leg taking about 12 seconds. All four turns occur on marked clear squares outside the shelf aisles.

title: Rack Imager Calibration Pass
description: Carry a calibrated stereo-imaging head on a low vibration-isolated mount on a four-module square body. Keep the cameras facing the rack and slide left along a 9 m rack face in about 100 seconds, stopping at six barcode panels. At the clear end bay, drive forward 0.8 m in 12 seconds and slide right along the adjacent rack to complete the return scan.

title: Trailer Side Channel Unload
description: Use a fore-and-aft pair to carry small accessory cartons from a stationary trailer through the 0.29 m clear channel beside its secured freight. Drive forward 8 m in about 85 seconds to reach the loader, then reverse along the channel with the loaded tray. Continue onto the indoor bay across a level, flush steel bridge plate; no turn or sideways correction is required.

title: Chilled Tote Stop Alignment
description: Carry a sealed chilled-food tote on a cold-rated two-module body to a manual picking stop in the refrigerated aisle. Drive forward 5.6 m in about 50 seconds, then slide left 0.24 m in 18 seconds to align the tote with two painted stop marks. Use 0.004 m/s for the last 24 mm and reverse 0.6 m after the operator removes the tote.

title: Mezzanine Conveyor Feed Loop
description: Move a tray of small cartons between a mezzanine packing bench and a stopped conveyor feed position on the same level. Drive forward 7 m in about 38 seconds, turn clockwise 90 degrees in 3.5 seconds, and go diagonally front-right 1.4 m in 10 seconds around a fixed cabinet. Slide left 0.2 m in 8 seconds for staff to transfer the cartons, then reverse 1 m clear of the conveyor.

title: Returns Tray Scale Positioning
description: Carry a tray of returned watch straps on one module from the inspection bench to a scale-side pickup mark. Go diagonally rear-left 1.2 m in about 15 seconds to clear the bench corner, then slide right 0.15 m in 14 seconds beneath the pickup guide. Finish the last 15 mm at 0.003 m/s so the operator can lift the tray straight onto the scale.

title: Mobile Rack Label Sprint
description: Carry a light packet of replacement location labels on a four-module square body down an opened mobile-racking aisle. Once the rack controls confirm the aisle is locked open, drive forward 24 m in about 95 seconds to the technician. Reverse along the same straight route after handoff; do not turn between the rack faces.

title: Pharmacy Tote Diagonal Dock
description: Carry a compartmented prescription tote on a four-module square body from the checking bench to a staff unloading dock. Drive forward 3.2 m in about 20 seconds, turn counter-clockwise 45 degrees in 5 seconds to match the dock face, then approach diagonally front-right for 0.9 m in about 14 seconds between two guide posts. Slide left 30 mm at 0.005 m/s for final alignment, and withdraw diagonally rear-left after staff unload the tote.

title: Search Behind Collapsed Corridor Panels
description: Carry a camera and acoustic pickup along a cleared, level strip beside fallen corridor panels using a 2x2 body. Advance 6 m with a 50-second cruise allowance, then slide left 0.3 m over 10 seconds through a gap between panel ends. Reverse along the same strip after recording; keep the body facing ahead because the gap has no turning clearance.

title: Check Smoke Obscured Office Alcoves
description: Send a single module with a thermal camera into three dead-end office alcoves from a cleared corridor. Each alcove requires a 3.6 m forward probe with a 24-second cruise allowance and a reverse exit on the same line. At each corridor junction, turn clockwise through 90 degrees over 5 seconds before entering the next branch.

title: Deliver Radio Through Garage Debris
description: Use three modules in a 0.6 m long single row to carry a radio pack along an 8.4 m swept lane to a responder station. Allow 40 seconds of straight cruising, then slide right 0.24 m over 8 seconds between two concrete blocks without rotating. After the responder removes the pack, slide left to the lane and reverse out.
