title: Place Basement Water Monitoring Kit
description: Carry a sealed water-monitoring kit on a 2x2 body across a verified flat basement floor with shallow standing water. Drive forward 4 m over a 50-second cruise window, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 10 seconds, and take a 1.2 m front-right diagonal across an open equipment bay over 20 seconds. Slide left 0.2 m over 10 seconds to the marked handoff point, then reverse 1 m after unloading.

title: Survey Tunnel Service Recesses
description: Move a docked pair carrying a camera and gas sensor along a 12 m cleared tunnel service passage after a quake. Stop at four widened recesses and turn in place 90 degrees clockwise to view each wall, then counter-clockwise to resume the route, allowing 3 seconds per turn. Straight travel has a combined 60-second cruise allowance; responders recover the body at the far end.

title: Move Evacuation Equipment Cache
description: Carry a 28 kg evacuation supply crate on a six-module 2x3 body from the hospital store to a staffed refuge point. Follow an 18 m clear corridor with 100 seconds allocated to straight cruising, then slide right 0.45 m over 15 seconds into the handoff bay without turning the crate. Staff unload the crate, and the body reverses 1.2 m into the corridor before the next assignment.

title: Inspect Flat Stairwell Landing
description: Place a single camera module on the middle of a flat stairwell landing to inspect four door faces. Move forward 1.2 m with a 15-second cruise allowance, then make three clockwise 90-degree turns in place, each over 6 seconds, pausing for images. Reverse along the entry line to the recovery mark without approaching either flight of stairs.

title: Relay Sensor To Fire Crew
description: Carry a replacement air-quality sensor along a 31.2 m warehouse aisle that has been cleared after a fire. The single module must reach the staffed monitoring point using a 120-second straight cruise allowance, with no turns or sideways corrections on the marked lane. After a brief handoff, reverse along the same aisle to the staging line.

title: Scan Evacuated Train Seating Bays
description: Use a docked pair with a thermal camera to check three seating bays in an evacuated, stationary train carriage. Advance a total of 9.6 m along the level aisle with 60 seconds allocated to straight cruising. At each seat-free vestibule, turn 90 degrees counter-clockwise in place over 5 seconds to inspect the bay, then clockwise over 5 seconds to face down the aisle again.

title: Replenish Refuge Chamber Supplies
description: Carry an 8.8 kg sealed supply pack from the refuge chamber entrance to its far supply rack along a 16.8 m straight internal lane. Use a 70-second cruise allowance each way, with the pair remaining aligned to the rack throughout. A responder unloads the pack, and the pair reverses to the entrance because the rack end has no turning space.

title: Map Narrow Cold Aisle Leaks
description: Arrange three modules in a 0.6 m long single row and carry a low thermal sensor bar down a 10.8 m data-centre cold aisle. Allocate 90 seconds to forward cruising, then slide left 0.12 m over 8 seconds to sample beside a rack plinth without changing heading. Slide right to the centreline and reverse out; the sensor bar stays within the body's 0.2 m width.

title: Transfer Fragile Inverter Reference Sensor
description: Carry an 18 kg padded optical reference assembly on a six-module 2x3 body from the inverter-room bench to a calibration stand. Follow a 7.2 m straight marked lane with 80 seconds of cruising, then slide right 0.48 m over 16 seconds beneath the stand's transfer shelf. Keep the assembly facing the same way and use gentle acceleration throughout; a technician performs the lift.

title: Photograph Wing Underside Access Panels
description: Carry an upward-facing camera on a docked pair between four marked stations under a parked aircraft wing. Travel forward a total of 14.4 m with an 80-second cruise allowance, using clear floor outside the landing-gear exclusion zones. At the stations, make two clockwise and two counter-clockwise 90-degree turns in place, allowing 2.5 seconds per turn to match the camera lighting direction.

title: Align Engine Room Gauge Camera
description: Move a single module carrying a close-focus camera to a gauge inspection mark on a level engine-room deck while the ship is secured alongside. Advance 1.8 m with 30 seconds of cruising, then slide left 0.09 m over 9 seconds and turn clockwise 6 degrees over 6 seconds to centre the gauge. Hold for images, undo the angle and sideways offset, and reverse to the starting mark.

title: Dock Turbine Hall Survey Platform
description: Carry a laser survey head on a 2x2 body along a 15.6 m marked turbine-hall lane with 60 seconds allocated to straight cruising. At the open end, keep the survey head facing the turbine and travel diagonally front-left 2.6 m over 10 seconds toward the docking station. Finish with a 0.12 m left slide over 8 seconds into the locating guides.

title: Inspect Pipe Gallery Valve Labels
description: Take a single camera module forward 5.4 m through a level pipe gallery with 45 seconds of cruising, then slide right 0.3 m over 10 seconds around a support foot. Cross a clear 0.9 m front-left diagonal over 10 seconds to the valve label and turn counter-clockwise 45 degrees over 5 seconds for a readable image. Retrace the diagonal rear-right, slide left, undo the turn before the return path, and reverse out.

title: Transport Underbridge Inspection Battery
description: Use three modules in a 0.6 m long single row to carry a 13.5 kg battery-and-logger case along an enclosed underside maintenance walkway. The level 18.9 m run has a 90-second cruise allowance, followed by a 0.18 m right slide over 9 seconds into a widened equipment recess. A technician removes the case; slide left and reverse back without turning on the walkway.

title: Dock Nacelle Borescope Equipment Cradle
description: Carry a 21 kg borescope equipment cradle on a six-module 2x3 body across a large turbine's level nacelle service floor during a locked-out inspection. Advance 3.6 m with 40 seconds of cruising, then keep the cradle aligned with the gearbox and travel diagonally front-right 0.84 m over 12 seconds into the service dock. After the inspection, withdraw diagonally rear-left and reverse to the lifting point.

title: Position Cleanroom Particle Mapping Rig
description: Carry a particle counter on a cleanroom-qualified 2x2 body forward 8.1 m through a service bay with 45 seconds of cruising. Slide left 0.36 m over 12 seconds, turn clockwise 90 degrees over 6 seconds in the open sampling square, then cross a 1.08 m front-right diagonal over 9 seconds to the second sample mark. After sampling, reverse 1.8 m along the newly aligned exit lane.

title: Scan Parking Structure Column Faces
description: Carry a crack-imaging camera on a docked pair around one square parking-structure column in a closed parking bay. Approach forward 6 m with 30 seconds of cruising, slide right 0.72 m over 8 seconds to clear the column, then take a 1.2 m front-left diagonal over 8 seconds to the second face. Turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 4 seconds for the final image, then reverse 2 m down the marked departure line.

title: Deliver Glass Reagent Supply Tray
description: Carry a 3.2 kg latched tray of glass reagent bottles from the hospital laboratory store to a staffed preparation counter. Follow a 13.2 m straight corridor with 110 seconds allocated to cruising, then slide left 0.24 m over 12 seconds into the counter's receiving position. Keep the tray level, use gentle starts and stops, and reverse 0.6 m after staff remove it.

title: Collect Hotel Room Service Trays
description: Carry an empty enclosed tray carrier on a docked pair to three staffed room-service collection points along a hotel corridor. Travel forward a total of 18 m with 100 seconds of cruising, turning clockwise 90 degrees in place at each widened doorway over 6 seconds so the carrier opening faces staff. After each tray is loaded, turn counter-clockwise over 6 seconds and continue, keeping the final payload below 8 kg.

title: Recover Bag From Inspection Spur
description: Send an empty docked pair forward 7.8 m into a fenced dead-end baggage inspection spur, allowing 30 seconds of straight cruising. An attendant secures a 9 kg cabin bag to the deck, and the pair reverses the full spur at the same cruise speed because the loading pocket has no turning room. Once clear of the fence, slide right 0.6 m over 6 seconds into the staffed transfer bay.

title: Exchange Kits In Blind Line Pocket
description: Carry a 26 kg component kit on a six-module 2x3 body along a 12 m factory supply lane with 50 seconds of cruising. Slide left 0.42 m over 7 seconds to line up with a blind line-side pocket, then enter forward 1.44 m over 12 seconds at the reduced approach speed. The operator exchanges the kit for an empty tote, and the body reverses out before sliding right and returning backward along the supply lane.

title: Retrieve Books From Return Nook
description: Send a docked pair with a low book tray into a dead-end return nook between library sorting shelves. Advance 4.8 m with 40 seconds of cruising, stop for staff to load up to 8.5 kg of books, and reverse along the same line because the nook is too narrow to turn. At the open sorting area, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees in place over 9 seconds and slide left 0.3 m over 10 seconds to present the tray.

title: Align Samples With Analyzer Shelf
description: Carry a sealed sample rack along the 3 m lab aisle to an analyzer receiving shelf. Drive forward with a 2 m cruise section covered in 20 seconds, then slide right 60 mm over 6 seconds to align the rack for manual transfer; keep the same heading throughout.

title: Rush Empty Trays To Restocking
description: Use a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body to carry a broad stack of empty display trays from receiving to the restocking bench. Travel forward down the clear backroom lane, covering its 13 m cruise section in 50 seconds, then slide left through a 0.9 m bench opening with a 0.6 m cruise section taking 5 seconds.

title: Thread Anchors Between Installed Cabinets
description: Carry boxed wall anchors on a 0.4 m square body across a finished indoor construction slab. Advance through a 0.46 m passage between fixed cabinets, covering a 1.2 m cruise section in 20 seconds, then slide right into the installation pocket with a 0.24 m cruise section taking 8 seconds; there is no room to turn.

title: Move Camera Through Product Shot
description: Carry a small cinema camera on a low vibration-isolated mount along a taped studio dolly path. Slide left through a 1.2 m constant-speed filming section in 30 seconds, then reverse along a 0.6 m clearance section in 10 seconds after the take; preserve the camera heading and use gentle starts and stops.

title: Deliver Gallery Label Repair Kit
description: Carry a label repair kit to four plinths in an empty gallery after closing. Drive forward between stops with 1.6 m cruise sections taking 10 seconds, and turn in place clockwise or counter-clockwise at each marked junction to present the kit toward the next plinth. Each 90-degree turn has a central 60-degree sweep completed in 2 seconds, with slower starts and finishes.

title: Collect Glass Vials From Picking
description: Move a padded vial carrier down a 0.38 m picking aisle using three modules docked in a 0.6 by 0.2 m line. Drive forward through a 3.6 m cruise section in 30 seconds, slide left 80 mm over 4 seconds beneath the handoff marker, and reverse out after the operator loads the carrier. Maintain the same heading because the aisle cannot accommodate a turn.

title: Shuttle Fragile Cross-Dock Sample Pallet
description: Carry a 0.18 m square miniature sample pallet of ceramic finish coupons between two cross-dock inspection benches; full freight pallets stay on forklifts. Move diagonally front-right across the marked apron, covering a 2.1 m cruise section in 15 seconds, then slide left 0.15 m over 5 seconds to meet the receiving guide.

title: Seat Tote At Packing Station
description: Carry a parts tote from a shelf handoff to a packing station on a 0.4 m square body. Drive forward along a 4.5 m cruise section in 25 seconds, slide right 0.12 m over 6 seconds to center between station guides, then creep forward the final 40 mm over 4 seconds. The operator lifts the tote after the body stops.

title: Scan Racks Then Dock Diagonally
description: Carry a low RFID reader along a rack face, driving forward through a 6 m scanning section in 40 seconds. At the aisle end, keep the reader heading fixed and travel diagonally front-left toward an offset charging pad, covering a 0.72 m approach section in 8 seconds. Slow below that approach speed for the final contact alignment.

title: Unload Small Parcels Inside Trailer
description: Working entirely inside a stationary trailer with a flat steel floor, carry one small parcel at a time from an operator to a portable takeaway conveyor at the door. Drive forward through 2.4 m cruise sections in 12 seconds and turn in place at the cleared pickup and conveyor squares, alternating clockwise and counter-clockwise turns. The middle 90 degrees of each turn takes 3 seconds; the robot never crosses the dock gap.

title: Align Frozen Reagent Transfer Box
description: Carry an insulated reagent box along a dry cold-storage aisle on a 0.4 m square body. Drive forward through a 2.8 m cruise section in 20 seconds, then slide left 45 mm over 5 seconds to center the box beneath the transfer hatch. Reverse 0.3 m after unloading, using a 0.18 m cruise section lasting 3 seconds.

title: Feed Cartons Across Mezzanine
description: Carry empty flat-pack cartons from a buffer stack to a conveyor feed point on the same mezzanine level. Drive forward through a guarded 10.8 m cruise section in 40 seconds, then slide right through a 0.48 m approach section in 4 seconds to present the stack to the attendant. The route stays well inside the mezzanine guardrails and uses no lift or stairs.

title: Retrieve Returns From Blind Bays
description: Use a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body to collect a tote from a blind returns bay. Enter forward along a 2.4 m cruise section in 15 seconds, wait for loading, then reverse along the same section in 20 seconds because the bay has no turning space. Once fully clear, slide left along a 0.9 m cruise section in 10 seconds to reach the sorting lane.

title: Transfer Stock Through Locked Racking
description: Carry a stock bin through a 0.45 m aisle opened between mobile racks using a 0.4 m square body. Move forward through a 1.8 m cruise section in 30 seconds, then slide right 15 mm over 3 seconds to position the bin at the marked shelf handoff. Reverse out on the same centerline after loading, following a leftward correction of the same size.

title: Dock Medication Tote At Verification
description: Carry a sealed medication tote from a staging shelf to an offset verification cradle. Drive forward through a 2.2 m cruise section in 10 seconds, then approach diagonally front-right through a 0.84 m section in 7 seconds without rotating the tote. Finish with a 30 mm rightward slide over 3 seconds so the tote label lines up with the fixed scanner.

title: Rush Search Camera Along Corridor
description: Send a two-module 0.4 by 0.2 m body with a low search camera down a swept, intact floor strip beside a corridor collapse. Drive forward through a verified clear 10.4 m cruise section in 40 seconds, then slide left through a 0.36 m section in 6 seconds to view behind a fallen partition. Stop before the rubble edge and transmit images without attempting to climb debris.

title: Search Around Smoke-Obscured Office Desks
description: Carry a thermal camera and air sensor across a smoke-filled office with an intact floor and a remotely verified route. Advance through a 1.2 m cruise section in 10 seconds, slide right through 0.3 m in 5 seconds to clear a desk, then move diagonally front-left through 0.64 m in 8 seconds toward a doorway. Turn clockwise in place with a central 40-degree sweep in 2 seconds to inspect the room, then reverse out along the clear doorway line.

title: Inspect Blind Garage Debris Pockets
description: Carry a listening sensor into two blind pockets between fallen panels on a structurally cleared parking-garage level. Use only swept concrete channels, entering forward through a 1.4 m cruise section in 20 seconds and reversing through it at the same speed because neither pocket has turning room. Between pockets, slide right through a clear 0.4 m section in 8 seconds without crossing loose debris.

title: Deliver Pump Kit Through Basement
description: Use a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body to carry a compact pump kit across a basement with a flat concrete floor covered by 3 mm of standing water. Drive forward through a surveyed 4.5 m cruise section in 50 seconds, then slide left through a 0.4 m section in 10 seconds to place the kit beside the sump crew. Use splash-protected modules approved for this water depth and keep the secured load low.

title: Survey Tunnel Service Recess
description: Carry a low crack-imaging unit along a flat service walkway in a tunnel cleared for robotic inspection after a quake. Drive forward through a 7.2 m cruise section in 40 seconds into a blind equipment recess, pause for imaging, then reverse out through the same section in 60 seconds. The 0.52 m recess admits the 0.4 m square body but provides no turning space.

title: Move Portable Monitor To Evacuation
description: Carry a disconnected portable patient monitor and its accessories from an evacuated treatment room to the corridor equipment point on a six-module body. Drive forward through a 6 m cruise section in 40 seconds, then slide right through a 0.6 m section in 10 seconds to park in an equipment alcove without turning the padded load. Staff keep the route clear during the move and remove the monitor by hand.

title: Place Radio On Stairwell Landing
description: Starting on the landing, carry a radio relay battery along the flat section beside a fixed service cabinet using a two-module 0.4 by 0.2 m body. Drive forward through a 0.8 m cruise section in 16 seconds within a 0.26 m channel, then slide left through a 0.12 m section in 6 seconds into a wider wall recess. Keep the long axis along the channel throughout and remain behind the marked setback from the stair edge.

title: Recover Fragile Fire Investigation Samples
description: Carry sealed glass residue jars in a padded carrier from an investigator's cleared sampling station to the warehouse exit handoff. Move diagonally rear-left across a clear 1.5 m cruise section in 15 seconds to avoid a wet patch, then reverse along a 3.2 m cruise section in 40 seconds while keeping the carrier's marked face toward the investigator. The floor is cool, swept and clear of hose lines.

title: Search Beneath Train Seat Rows
description: Starting inside a stationary, level train carriage, carry a low inspection camera down the central aisle to a blind seat-end gap. Drive forward through a 4.8 m cruise section in 30 seconds, slide right through a 0.24 m section in 6 seconds to inspect the gap, then slide left back into the aisle. Reverse through the original cruise section in 40 seconds because turning space is blocked by responders' equipment.

title: Align Supplies At Refuge Hatch
description: Carry a sealed water-and-radio supply pack across the level floor inside a mine refuge chamber using a two-module 0.4 by 0.2 m body. Drive forward through a 1.5 m cruise section in 20 seconds, turn counter-clockwise in a cleared square with a central 30-degree sweep in 3 seconds, then slide left 35 mm over 5 seconds to align with the low transfer hatch. Creep forward the final 25 mm over 5 seconds for an attendant to take the pack.

title: Cold Aisle Sensor Delivery
description: Carry a padded tray of calibrated airflow probes along a 9 m cold aisle to the rack technician, allowing 75 seconds for steady forward travel. Keep the tray facing the racks and slide left 0.24 m over 12 seconds into the receiving position; no turning is required.

title: Inverter Cabinet Recess Survey
description: Carry a thermal camera on three modules docked in a straight 0.6 m line into a cabinet recess with no turning space. Drive forward along the 4.2 m inspection line in 35 seconds, stop for images, then reverse out along the same line in 28 seconds with the rear clearance sensor active.

title: Underwing Leak Camera Withdrawal
description: Move a low camera and collection-pad tray under a parked aircraft wing to inspect a suspected hydraulic drip beside a landing-gear fixture. Three modules in a straight line advance 3.6 m in 40 seconds and reverse the same distance after inspection, then slide right 0.45 m over 9 seconds once clear of the fixture.

title: Engine Room Acoustic Survey
description: Carry a compact acoustic recorder along an 11.7 m clear engine-room deck lane during a dockside maintenance shutdown, covering the steady transit in 45 seconds. At the open machinery bay, turn clockwise in place through 90 degrees over 3 seconds to aim the recorder at the next measurement point.

title: Turbine Hall Vibration Route
description: Carry a secured vibration logger from the instrument bench to a turbine bearing inspection station along a straight 42 m marked lane. Travel forward at a steady pace for 168 seconds between acceleration zones, keeping the logger facing the station throughout.

title: Pipe Gallery Valve Inspection
description: Carry a camera head on a 2-by-2 body through a level enclosed pipe gallery, driving forward along a 6 m lane in 40 seconds before turning counter-clockwise 90 degrees in 5 seconds inside a widened bay. Slide left 0.36 m in 6 seconds to clear a support, approach the valve diagonally front-right along a 0.84 m path in 12 seconds, and reverse 0.6 m after imaging.

title: Enclosed Bridge Walkway Survey
description: Carry an inspection camera and lighting pack along the enclosed, level maintenance walkway inside a box-girder bridge beneath the road deck. The 2-by-3 body drives forward 12 m to a closed bulkhead and reverses the full distance because the 0.72 m walkway has no turning bay, allowing 100 seconds of travel each way.

title: Nacelle Borescope Kit Positioning
description: Carry a 13.8 kg borescope and fixture kit from its storage cradle to the gearbox inspection port inside a stopped wind-turbine nacelle. Three modules docked lengthwise travel forward 2.8 m over 40 seconds on a continuous level floor strip, then slide left 0.18 m over 12 seconds to place the case beside the technician.

title: Cleanroom Optical Reference Transfer
description: Carry a shock-isolated optical reference assembly across a cleanroom metrology bay on a 2-by-2 body. Follow a 2.16 m front-left diagonal path over 36 seconds, then slide right 0.12 m over 10 seconds to align the tray with the receiving fixture without rotating it.

title: Parking Column Scanner Docking
description: Carry a compact column scanner along a 5.4 m lane on an enclosed parking level, taking 30 seconds of steady forward travel. Approach the charging target beside the column diagonally front-right along a 0.72 m path over 12 seconds, then reverse 0.15 m slowly if the scanner needs a second reading.

title: Hospital Dressing Cart Handoff
description: Carry a sealed dressing-supply cassette from the clean store along an 18 m hospital service corridor, allowing 90 seconds of steady forward travel. At the ward hatch, keep the cassette facing forward and move diagonally front-left along a 0.9 m path over 15 seconds into a recessed receiving position.

title: Hotel Breakfast Tray Delivery
description: Carry a restrained breakfast tray with porcelain cups and covered juice glasses along a 12 m hotel corridor, using 100 seconds of steady forward travel. At the room-service alcove, turn clockwise in place through 90 degrees over 10 seconds, then slide right 0.3 m over 10 seconds to present the tray.

title: Baggage Inspection Tray Return
description: Return a shallow tray of small cleared baggage items from an inspection desk to a conveyor handoff in the airport baggage hall. Drive forward 15.6 m in 60 seconds along the protected lane, then move diagonally front-right along a 1.35 m path in 15 seconds to enter the angled receiving pocket.

title: Assembly Cell Kit Exchange
description: Take a fastener kit into a blind line-side pocket between two fixed benches using a lengthwise two-module body. Advance 2.4 m in 20 seconds, wait for the operator to exchange the cassette, and reverse 2.4 m in 16 seconds because the pocket is too narrow to turn.

title: Library Return Bin Docking
description: Carry a compact bin of returned books through a 7.2 m staff sorting aisle in 60 seconds. The station stands behind the starting side of a desk end, so keep the book spines facing the sorter and move diagonally rear-left along a 0.6 m path over 12 seconds into its docking marks.

title: Laboratory Batch Rack Express
description: Carry a lightweight, wide rack of capped sample tubes on a 2-by-3 body between two laboratory pass-through stations. Use the reserved 20.1 m corridor for a 75-second steady forward transit, then slide right 0.48 m in 8 seconds to align the rack with the receiving shelf.

title: Backroom Blind Aisle Restock
description: Carry a secured carton of toiletries down a 5.6 m blind backroom aisle to the shelf replenishment point on a 2-by-2 body. Drive forward in 40 seconds and reverse out in 35 seconds after unloading, then slide left 0.8 m over 10 seconds in the clear cross aisle to reach the empty-carton station.

title: Indoor Fitout Parts Circuit
description: Deliver a secured tray of door hardware to four marked workstations on a swept indoor slab. Travel forward along three 4.8 m legs in 30 seconds each, turning in place through 90 degrees at each clear junction in 2.5 seconds, with both clockwise and counter-clockwise turns needed to follow the partition layout.

title: Miniature Set Camera Moves
description: Carry a compact remote camera on a low bracket through a miniature film set, creeping forward and reversing along a 1.2 m track in 24 seconds each way. Between takes, turn in place clockwise and counter-clockwise through 60 degrees over 5 seconds to frame alternating doorways without moving the camera base to another mark.

title: Museum Plinth Base Relocation
description: Move a compact 27 kg steel plinth base between display positions after the gallery closes, using six modules in a 2-by-3 block with the load centered and restrained. Travel forward 6.3 m over 90 seconds, then slide left 0.32 m over 16 seconds to place the base beside the curator's floor marks.

title: Express Small Parts Picking
description: Carry a lightweight pick bin on a lengthwise two-module body down a reserved 13 m narrow aisle, covering the clear transit in 50 seconds. At the pick face, slide right 0.1 m over 5 seconds for loading, slide left to regain the centerline, and reverse down the aisle at the same transit pace.

title: Fragile Mini Pallet Shuttle
description: Shuttle a 0.58 by 0.38 m miniature pallet of boxed glass instrument parts between two cross-dock benches on a six-module body. Drive forward 8.4 m over 70 seconds, then move diagonally front-right along a 0.64 m path over 16 seconds to reach the receiving marks without rotating the pallet.

title: Tote Transfer Nest Alignment
description: Carry a loaded tote from a shelf handoff to a packing station on a 2-by-3 body, driving forward 10.2 m in 60 seconds. At the transfer nest, slide left 0.096 m over 8 seconds, creep forward the final 0.12 m, and reverse 0.12 m after the station lifts off the tote; the nest has only 8 mm of side clearance.

title: Alternating Rack Inventory Scan
description: Carry a small barcode imager through a rack inspection aisle, advancing in 2.4 m intervals over 12 seconds each. At four marked scan pads, turn in place 180 degrees in 4 seconds, alternating clockwise and counter-clockwise to face opposite rack rows before continuing forward along the newly faced direction.

title: Level Trailer Carton Withdrawal
description: Receive a dense 9.6 kg carton on a two-module body inside a restrained trailer at an enclosed loading bay. Reverse 7.2 m out of the trailer over 60 seconds across a secured flush bridge plate with no slope, then slide right 0.42 m over 7 seconds to the unload bench while keeping the carton facing the trailer.

title: Cold Aisle Sample Retrieval
description: Collect a sealed sample tote from the dead end of a refrigerated picking aisle and bring it back to the staging bench. The module must drive forward along a 4.2 m cruise section in 28 seconds, then reverse over the same section at the same speed because there is no turning pocket. Allow additional time for slow docking and tote handoff.

title: Mezzanine Conveyor Cassette Delivery
description: Carry a carton cassette across the level mezzanine to a conveyor feed station using a square four-module body. The 6.3 m cruise section must take 35 seconds, after which the body must slide right through a 0.46 m opening, covering the final 0.36 m in 12 seconds without turning. After unloading, slide left and reverse to the staging mark along the same route.

title: Returns Bench Side Insertion
description: Move a tray of returned handheld scanners from the intake scale to an inspection bench behind fixed tote stands. Drive forward over a 2.8 m cruise section in 20 seconds, then slide left 0.56 m in 16 seconds through the 0.27 m gap between the stands. After inspection staff remove the tray, slide right and reverse back to the scale without turning.

title: Mobile Rack Inventory Shuttle
description: Deliver a replacement label cartridge to the far end of an opened mobile-racking aisle. The module must cover the 16.2 m straight cruise section in 60 seconds and reverse back after the operator takes the cartridge. The rack controls remain locked against movement throughout the job, and the module never turns inside the aisle.

title: Pharmacy Tote Presentation Circuit
description: Carry a locked medication tote between three verification faces around a pharmacy packing cell. Each straight approach has a 1.08 m cruise section allotted 12 seconds, and the module must turn in place counter-clockwise through 90 degrees in 3 seconds at each successive face. At the final face, turn clockwise through 180 degrees in 6 seconds and drive forward to the release station.

title: Collapsed Corridor Camera Probe
description: Send a two-module body lengthwise down a cleared strip of intact corridor floor to inspect a blocked doorway with a thermal camera. It must drive forward along a 3.6 m cruise section in 30 seconds, pause for images, and reverse out at the same speed because fallen partitions close the end. No part of the route requires crossing rubble or entering an unsupported floor area.

title: Office Smoke Sensor Dash
description: Carry a lightweight gas sensor and thermal camera on a square four-module body to a marked observation point on a smoke-filled office floor released for robotic entry. Drive forward along the 13 m corridor cruise section in 50 seconds, then go diagonally front-left across a cleared 3.3 m lobby segment in 15 seconds. Return diagonally rear-right and reverse down the corridor after taking the readings.

title: Garage Rescue Supply Run
description: Deliver a sealed rescue-tool case along a cleared lane through debris on a level parking-garage floor. A square four-module body must drive forward over a 19.2 m cruise section in 80 seconds, stop at the crew's marked handoff point, and reverse along the same lane. The lane ends before the damaged area and has no usable turning pocket.

title: Basement Waterline Survey
description: Carry a camera and water-quality probe between three marked stations on a flat basement floor with a shallow water film. The water-rated two-module body must drive forward over 1.6 m cruise sections in 20 seconds and turn in place in either direction to face wall markings, allowing 10 seconds for each 90-degree turn. Stop at every station before lowering the probe.

title: Quake Tunnel Joint Survey
description: Move a camera and laser measurement head along the flat service floor of an indoor utility tunnel after structural clearance. Drive forward between joint stations over 4.4 m cruise sections in 20 seconds, then turn in place clockwise and counter-clockwise to inspect opposite walls, allocating 5 seconds to each 90-degree turn. The two-module body rotates only on the marked widened pads.

title: Evacuation Alcove Supply Delivery
description: Bring a bag of evacuation blankets and patient identification supplies to staff in a dead-end hospital holding alcove. The square four-module body must drive forward along a 6.6 m corridor cruise section in 30 seconds, then slide right 0.72 m in 12 seconds to reach the handoff mark beside a parked bed. Slide left and reverse out after unloading; the bed leaves insufficient room to turn.

title: Extended Landing Equipment Shuttle
description: Shuttle a casualty-care equipment bag along the unusually long, level landing of an enclosed industrial stairwell. The square four-module body must drive forward through a 10.8 m straight cruise section in 45 seconds and reverse back after the crew unloads it. Both transfer marks are on the same landing, with rigid barriers separating the travel lane from every stair opening.

title: Postfire Sensor Cartridge Courier
description: Carry a fresh air-sampling cartridge from the warehouse entry station to a monitoring crew after the fire is extinguished. Drive forward along a cleared 8.1 m cruise section in 30 seconds, then go diagonally front-right over a 2.4 m section in 12 seconds to reach the crew behind a rack end. After exchanging cartridges, return diagonally rear-left and reverse to the entry station.

title: Carriage Medical Kit Placement
description: Deliver a medical kit inside a stationary, level train carriage, starting from an onboard staging area. A square four-module body must drive forward through a 4.8 m aisle cruise section in 30 seconds, turn clockwise in place through 90 degrees in 9 seconds in the vestibule, and travel diagonally front-left 0.9 m in 10 seconds around a fixed partition. Slide right 0.42 m in 7 seconds to present the kit, then retrace the route using left sway, rear-right diagonal travel, a counter-clockwise turn, and reverse surge.

title: Refuge Chamber Consumables Shuttle
description: Move a sealed carton of drinking water and replacement respirator filters from the refuge chamber supply hatch to its occupied far end. On the chamber's level enclosed floor, the square four-module body must drive forward along an 11.5 m cruise section in 50 seconds. Reverse back after unloading, keeping the central access lane clear and avoiding the seating recesses.

title: Cold Aisle Thermal Sweep
description: Carry a lightweight thermal camera down a data-centre cold aisle to compare inlet temperatures at two rack rows. The two-module body must drive forward over a 15.6 m cruise section in 60 seconds, slide left 0.66 m in 6 seconds at the open end, and reverse down the second scan line at the same surge speed. Keep the camera facing the same direction throughout the sweep.

title: Inverter Cabinet Thermal Circuit
description: Carry an infrared inspection head between four cabinet faces inside a solar-farm inverter room. The square four-module body must drive forward along 2.7 m cruise sections in 18 seconds and turn in place clockwise or counter-clockwise through 90 degrees in 4 seconds to face successive cabinets. Capture each image while stationary on a marked turning pad.

title: Underwing Leak Camera Retrieval
description: Send a low-mounted ultraviolet camera beneath a parked aircraft wing to photograph a suspected hydraulic leak behind a service stand. The two-module body must drive lengthwise forward over a 5.1 m cruise section in 30 seconds, then slide left 0.48 m in 12 seconds into the viewing slot. Slide right and reverse out after imaging because the stand and landing gear prevent an in-place turn.

title: Engine Room Reference Instrument Transfer
description: Carry a fragile reference vibration analyzer in a padded cradle from the instrument locker to a pump inspection station on the same engine-room deck. The two-module body must drive forward over a 3.3 m cruise section in 30 seconds and slide right 0.45 m in 15 seconds to meet the technician's transfer fixture. After the instrument is removed, slide left and reverse along the same route, using gentle starts and stops throughout.

title: Turbine Hall Gauge Reading Circuit
description: Carry a camera mast along a designated turbine-hall gauge route using three modules docked in a straight row. Drive forward over 3.36 m cruise sections in 24 seconds and turn in place in either direction through 120 degrees in 8 seconds at the marked viewing bays. Each bay provides enough space for the full body sweep, and readings are taken only after rotation stops.

title: Pipe Gallery Acoustic Traverse
description: Move an acoustic leak logger through a long enclosed pipe gallery on a flat service floor. The three-module straight body must drive forward over a 21.6 m cruise section in 90 seconds, with additional stationary listening stops, then reverse to the entry. Keep the body lengthwise between the pipe supports because the gallery has no turning bay.

title: Enclosed Bridge Walkway Joint Survey
description: Carry an upward-facing joint camera along a fully enclosed maintenance walkway beneath a bridge deck. The three-module straight body must drive forward through a 24.3 m cruise section in 90 seconds, stopping separately at marked joints, and reverse back to the access room. The entire route stays inside the level enclosure on continuous flooring, with no ladders or exterior deck travel.

title: Nacelle Gearbox Camera Withdrawal
description: Inspect the underside of a gearbox from a dead-end service slot inside a shut-down wind-turbine nacelle. Starting from an onboard staging pad, the three-module straight body must drive forward over a 2.1 m cruise section in 30 seconds and reverse out after recording the seals. The 0.31 m slot admits the body lengthwise but provides no room to turn, and the route crosses no hatch or raised cable cover.

title: Cleanroom Optical Standard Delivery
description: Carry a sealed optical calibration standard in a vibration-isolated cradle from cleanroom storage to an inspection tool. The cleanroom-approved two-module body must go diagonally front-right across a 2.16 m open-bay cruise section in 24 seconds, then slide left 0.32 m in 16 seconds into the transfer fixture. After the standard is removed, slide right and return diagonally rear-left, keeping the cradle orientation fixed and using gentle acceleration.

title: Parking Column Recess Scan
description: Carry a crack-mapping camera into a blind inspection recess between a parking-structure column and a fixed utility enclosure. The square four-module body must drive forward over a 4.32 m cruise section in 24 seconds, then slide right 0.54 m in 9 seconds to establish the camera standoff. Slide left and reverse out after scanning because wheel stops block the recess beyond the column and leave no turning space.

title: Deliver Glass Infusion Bottles
description: Carry a padded tray of glass infusion bottles from the supply room to the ward hatch along an 18 m corridor, allowing 120 seconds for the straight travel. Keep the two-module body facing the hatch and slide 0.45 m left over 9 seconds beneath its receiving shelf. Staff lift the tray off without the robot turning.

title: Move Breakfast Service Trays
description: Carry three covered breakfast trays on a six-module rectangular deck along 24 m of hotel corridor in about three minutes. Turn clockwise through 90 degrees in the 1.5 m service lobby over 12 seconds, then slide 0.6 m right in 15 seconds to meet the room-service handoff table. Cups sit in recessed holders and the attendant removes the trays.

title: Transfer Dense Tool Baggage
description: Move a strapped 14.5 kg tool case from the oversize-baggage desk to the inspection table along a fenced 30 m lane. Cover the straight leg in 125 seconds, then slide 0.8 m left over 12 seconds beside the table without rotating the three-module body. A handler transfers the case at each end.

title: Replenish Assembly Fixture Kits
description: Take a 6 kg component kit 12 m down the line in 65 seconds, then turn counter-clockwise through 90 degrees in the marked junction within 5 seconds. Travel 2.1 m diagonally front-right across the station apron in 14 seconds and slide 0.3 m right over 6 seconds into the handoff position. After the kit is removed, reverse 1.5 m out of the station over 12 seconds.

title: Return Bound Journal Stacks
description: Carry a strapped stack of bound journals from the return counter to the shelving worktable through a 16 m aisle. Allow 110 seconds for the loaded straight leg and slide 0.5 m right in 10 seconds to present the stack to the librarian. Reverse along the same aisle after unloading because the worktable end has no turning space.

title: Collect Samples From Analyzer Alcove
description: Enter a 5 m dead-end analyzer alcove carrying an empty secured sample carrier, taking about 50 seconds. A technician loads sealed sample tubes, after which the three-module strip must reverse the full 5 m in 70 seconds because it cannot turn between the benches. At the open end, slide 0.4 m left over 10 seconds to the collection hatch.

title: Restock Cosmetics Through Backroom
description: Carry a small cosmetics carton 9 m through the backroom in 45 seconds and turn clockwise through 90 degrees in the clear stockroom junction in 4 seconds. Cross a 1.4 m front-left diagonal gap between fixed cage corners in 10 seconds, then slide 0.35 m left over 7 seconds beside the shelf. Reverse 2 m over 15 seconds after staff remove the carton.

title: Deliver Fixings Into Service Recess
description: Carry two closed boxes of fixings along a swept indoor slab to a crew working in a 7 m dead-end service recess. Drive into the recess in 55 seconds, wait while the crew unloads, and reverse the same distance in 65 seconds without turning. Slide 0.6 m right in 10 seconds at the recess mouth to clear the next delivery.

title: Track Tabletop Product Shot
description: Carry a compact camera and low mounting plate through a rehearsed tabletop product shot on the studio floor. Move forward 2.4 m in 30 seconds, slide 1.2 m left in 20 seconds, then travel 1.5 m diagonally rear-right in 25 seconds while keeping the camera heading fixed. Between takes, turn counter-clockwise through 30 degrees in 10 seconds and reverse to the taped starting position.

title: Distribute Gallery Label Packs
description: Carry a small pack of replacement labels and mounting clips to six exhibit plinths after closing. Travel 3 m between stops in about 20 seconds, turning in place clockwise or counter-clockwise at each open junction to face the next plinth. Each 90-degree reorientation has a 3-second movement window before the conservator collects the next packet.

title: Dock Beneath Angled Picking Shelf
description: Carry a picking tote 11 m along a narrow rack aisle in 60 seconds on a four-module square. At the widened aisle end, approach the receiving nest along a 1.7 m front-left diagonal over 16 seconds without changing heading. Finish with a 0.12 m left slide over 6 seconds to line up the tote transfer marks.

title: Shuttle Mini Pallet Across Dock
description: Carry a 32 kg strapped mini pallet, sized for an eight-module 0.8 by 0.4 m deck, between two floor-level cross-dock stations. Cover the 28 m fenced straight lane in 115 seconds, then follow a 2.8 m front-right diagonal into the receiving bay over 18 seconds. Slide 0.2 m right over 8 seconds for manual transfer onto the station.

title: Present Tote Faces At Stations
description: Move a compartmented tote between three shelf ends and a packing station along 6 m connecting lanes, allowing 35 seconds per lane. At each 0.9 m square transfer pad, turn in place through 90 degrees in either direction to present the required tote face. Each turn takes 4 seconds, followed by a 0.25 m left or right slide over 5 seconds to the transfer edge.

title: Scan Long Rack Faces
description: Carry a low-mounted inventory camera along two 42 m rack faces, giving each straight scanning pass 170 seconds. At the open aisle end, slide 1.1 m right over 12 seconds and reverse down the second face while keeping the camera assembly at the same heading. Fixed cameras on opposite sides of the rig read the two rack faces.

title: Unload Cartons Inside Level Trailer
description: Shuttle a strapped carton bundle from a handler inside a stationary trailer to a receiving table 8 m away inside the same trailer. Cover each loaded leg in 50 seconds and turn in place through 180 degrees at the marked clear pads at both ends, alternating clockwise and counter-clockwise turns over 7 seconds each. The six-module body stays entirely on the trailer floor throughout the job.

title: Rotate Chilled Ingredient Crates
description: Carry a lidded ingredient crate between four collection points in a chilled room using 5 m straight legs of about 40 seconds each. At each widened rack end, turn in place clockwise or counter-clockwise through 90 degrees over 8 seconds so the crate label faces the picker. Slide 0.3 m right over 10 seconds at the final weighing station.

title: Feed Dead-End Mezzanine Conveyor
description: Carry a small carton along a 6 m guarded mezzanine lane to a stopped conveyor feed shelf in 40 seconds. After an operator transfers the carton, reverse the full 6 m in 45 seconds because the conveyor enclosure blocks any turn. Slide 0.4 m left over 8 seconds into the waiting pocket at the lane entrance; all travel remains on the same mezzanine level.

title: Run Returns To Inspection
description: Take a strapped returns tote down a 38 m segregated lane to the inspection bench in 155 seconds. Slide 0.5 m left over 7 seconds for unloading, then slide right back into the lane and reverse to the intake desk. The three-module strip keeps its heading throughout the out-and-back run.

title: Extract Dense Archive Parts Tote
description: Carry a 14.8 kg tote of metal spares out of a temporarily opened mobile-racking aisle on a three-module strip. Enter the 9 m aisle empty in 65 seconds, wait for staff to load the tote, and reverse out in 85 seconds because there is no turning pocket. Once fully clear of the racks, slide 0.7 m right over 14 seconds to the weighing bench.

title: Index Pharmacy Order Compartments
description: Carry a divided order tray around a pharmacy fulfilment cell with 2 m straight moves between dispensing counters, each taking 18 seconds. At five clear transfer pads, turn in place through 90 degrees clockwise or counter-clockwise over 10 seconds to present the correct compartment to the technician. Finish each presentation with a 0.1 m left slide over 5 seconds against the optical alignment marks.

title: Place Acoustic Sensor Beyond Collapse
description: Carry a shock-isolated acoustic listening unit along an 8 m intact floor strip beside a partial corridor collapse, taking two minutes to reach the listening position. Keep the body heading fixed and slide 0.4 m left over 12 seconds into a cleared wall recess for a 60-second recording. Slide right out of the recess and reverse along the same cleared strip with the sensor still aboard.

title: Search Blind Office Bays
description: Carry a low thermal camera and air sensor along a smoke-filled office corridor cleared for remote robot entry. Enter three 4 m dead-end office bays in about 45 seconds each and reverse out over the same interval because the furniture leaves no turning space. Between bays, turn in place through 90 degrees in the clear corridor junction over 6 seconds and advance to the next doorway.

title: Carry Optical Survey Instrument
description: Take a padded optical survey instrument across a 10 m swept strip on an intact parking-garage slab in 100 seconds. Follow a 2.1 m front-right diagonal over 30 seconds between two stationary debris piles, then slide 0.3 m right over 10 seconds to the survey technician. Keep the instrument upright and make no turns while it is aboard.

title: Map Basement Water Entry Points
description: Carry a protected inspection camera between four leak observation points on a flat basement floor covered by a shallow water film. Move 3 m between points in about 50 seconds, then turn in place clockwise or counter-clockwise through 90 degrees over 12 seconds to aim the camera at each wall joint. Use a 0.2 m left or right slide over 8 seconds where pipe guards block a direct view.

title: Transport Tunnel Crack Imaging Rig
description: Carry a fragile structured-light crack-imaging rig along 22 m of a level tunnel service passage after the floor route has been checked, allowing 200 seconds for the approach. Move 1.4 m diagonally rear-left over 25 seconds into a widened observation recess without rotating the rig, then hold still for a 90-second scan. Travel diagonally front-right out of the recess and reverse to the entry station with the rig aboard.

title: Oxygen Kit Through Bed Queue
description: Carry a secured oxygen response kit from the corridor store to the evacuation marshal, 9 m away. The two-module body travels with its 0.2 m edge across a 0.28 m gap between parked beds, then slides right 0.36 m into the receiving recess without turning. Use 0.18 m/s on the clear corridor and take 12 seconds for the sideways transfer.

title: Fragile Vials Across Stair Landing
description: Move a padded case of emergency medication 1.8 m across the level stairwell landing to the medical attendant. Stay inside the marked route behind the stair barrier, travelling forward at 0.045 m/s before sliding left 0.24 m over 12 seconds to the handoff mark. Staff load and unload the case; the robot never enters a stair flight.

title: Pump Delivery After Warehouse Fire
description: Carry a restrained drainage pump and hose bundle 16 m along a cleared, level lane to the recovery crew. The six-module body cruises forward at 0.16 m/s with the heavy load, turns clockwise 90 degrees over 15 seconds in a 1.4 m staging square, then advances another 3 m. The route has been released for entry after structural and atmosphere checks.

title: First Aid Kits Between Seats
description: Move a low crate of first aid kits 7 m down an immobilized train carriage to the responder at the far vestibule. The 0.4 m square body passes between seat ends only 0.48 m apart at 0.10 m/s. At a missing-seat bay, slide left 0.45 m over 15 seconds to clear the aisle for responders, keeping the same heading throughout.

title: Scrubber Cartridge Refuge Delivery
description: Carry a replacement air-scrubber cartridge from the refuge chamber storage wall to the service cradle, following a 4.2 m forward lane at 0.14 m/s. Approach the cradle along a marked 0.84 m front-left diagonal at 0.042 m/s, preserving the cartridge's heading to match its keyed tray. The crew completes the cartridge exchange after the body stops.

title: Optical Reference Through Cold Aisle
description: Carry a vibration-isolated optical reference beside three rack inspection stations spaced 2.4 m apart. Travel forward at 0.08 m/s between stations and slide right 0.12 m over 8 seconds at each one to place the reference beside the rack camera. Slide left by the same amount before continuing; keep the reference facing the racks throughout.

title: Inverter Row Thermal Survey
description: Carry a thermal scanner and its battery along a 36 m indoor inverter row, pausing at six marked cabinets. Use 0.26 m/s on the clear straight sections to keep the survey within five minutes. Turn counter-clockwise 180 degrees in the 1.6 m end bay over 10 seconds, then return down the same lane.

title: Wing Panel Camera Positioning
description: Move a low inspection camera rig 5 m beneath a parked aircraft wing at 0.125 m/s. At the marked panel, slide left 0.18 m over 18 seconds and rotate clockwise 6 degrees over 12 seconds to align the camera with the fastener row. Hold for the image sequence, then reverse 0.5 m at 0.05 m/s before the technician approaches.

title: Engine Room Sideways Sensor Pass
description: Carry an acoustic inspection recorder through a level machinery gap 0.49 m wide. Orient the six-module block with its 0.4 m dimension across the gap and slide right along the 3.6 m passage at 0.06 m/s, keeping the sensors pointed toward the engine casing. Slide left along the same route after a 30-second recording stop; do not turn between the machines.

title: Bearing Alcove Inspection Retreat
description: Carry a thermal camera into three blind bearing-service alcoves off a turbine hall aisle. Each alcove is 2.8 m deep and 0.36 m wide, so the pair enters lengthwise at 0.14 m/s and reverses out along its entry line at 0.07 m/s. Turn clockwise 90 degrees over 3 seconds only in the broad aisle when selecting the next alcove.

title: Pipe Joint Gauge Registration
description: Move a laser joint gauge on a straight three-module body 6 m through a level pipe gallery at 0.12 m/s. At each of two inspection marks, slide right 0.09 m over 15 seconds, hold for measurement, then slide left to the travel line. Keep the gauge parallel to the pipe; no rotation is needed.

title: Enclosed Bridge Walkway Joint Survey
description: Carry a joint camera along the level, enclosed maintenance walkway inside a bridge box girder. Travel forward 8 m at 0.20 m/s, slide left 0.3 m over 5 seconds around a bracket, and follow a 1.2 m front-right diagonal at 0.12 m/s to the viewing mark. Rotate counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 6 seconds for the image, then reverse 1 m at 0.10 m/s to clear the access hatch.

title: Nacelle Analyzer Battery Transfer
description: Carry a 19 kg vibration analyzer and battery pack 3 m from the nacelle service platform to the gearbox inspection position. The four-module body is already inside the stopped turbine and advances at 0.075 m/s through the level equipment lane. Slide right 0.4 m over 20 seconds into the inspection pocket without rotating the heavy pack.

title: Cleanroom Reference Wafer Delivery
description: Carry a sealed reference-wafer case 4.8 m from the inspection cabinet to the metrology bay using a cleanroom-qualified pair. Travel forward at 0.06 m/s with gentle starts, then move along a 0.48 m front-right diagonal over 24 seconds to the receiving outline. Preserve the case heading and let the technician lift it from the deck.

title: Column Crack Scanner Registration
description: Move a small crack-imaging camera 2.4 m to a column in an enclosed parking level at 0.12 m/s. Slide left 0.06 m over 12 seconds and turn counter-clockwise 4 degrees over 8 seconds to center an existing crack in the camera view. Hold for a 30-second exposure sequence while the parking bay remains closed.

title: Ward Supply Tote Orientation Circuit
description: Carry a latched supply tote on a straight three-module body between four ward collection points along a 24 m hospital route. Cruise forward at 0.24 m/s, stopping in marked 1 m turning squares to face the tote label toward staff. Make six alternating clockwise and counter-clockwise 90-degree turns, each over 2.5 seconds.

title: Breakfast Tray Through Service Pinch
description: Carry two covered breakfast settings on a secured low tray 10.5 m down the hotel service corridor at 0.15 m/s. Pass through a 0.47 m gap beside a parked linen cart with the square body held straight. At the room-service alcove, slide right 0.35 m over 14 seconds for staff to collect the tray without blocking the corridor.

title: Exception Bag Conveyor Docking
description: Carry one tagged exception bag 12 m from the manual screening table toward a stopped transfer conveyor at 0.25 m/s. Follow the marked 2.16 m front-left diagonal approach at 0.24 m/s across the clear docking apron. Finish with a 0.15 m forward creep at 0.015 m/s so an attendant can transfer the bag.

title: Assembly Cell Kit Replenishment
description: Carry a 26 kg fastener kit 15 m down the line-side aisle at 0.25 m/s. Turn clockwise 90 degrees over 5 seconds in the cell apron, slide left 0.8 m at 0.08 m/s, then approach the receiving stand along a 0.6 m front-right diagonal at 0.04 m/s. After the operator removes the kit, reverse 1.2 m at 0.12 m/s to clear the stand.

title: Rare Book Return to Conservation
description: Carry a returned rare volume in a fitted archival cradle from the secure return desk to the conservation room, 6.4 m away. Travel forward at 0.08 m/s with gradual starts and stops, keeping the cradle facing the same direction. Slide left 0.2 m over 20 seconds beside the receiving table for the conservator to lift the volume.

title: Sample Rack Hatch Alignment
description: Carry a sealed secondary container of sample tubes 3.6 m from the preparation bench to the analyzer pass-through at 0.12 m/s. Slide right 0.048 m over 12 seconds to align the container with the hatch centerline, then creep forward the final 0.08 m at 0.008 m/s. Stop at the floor mark while the technician transfers the container through the hatch.

title: Carton Restock Behind Rolling Racks
description: Carry a strapped carton of toiletries through a 0.46 m gap between fixed rolling racks to the shelf-filling station 5.4 m away. Advance the four-module square at 0.09 m/s without turning in the gap. At the widened station, slide left 0.42 m over 14 seconds; after unloading, slide right and reverse along the entry lane.

title: Anchor Kit Into Partition Recess
description: Carry an anchor kit on a straight three-module body into a 4.5 m blind recess between newly installed indoor partitions. Advance at 0.15 m/s on the swept slab, stop for the installer to remove the kit, then reverse the full distance at 0.09 m/s because the 0.38 m passage has no turning space. The route ends before the unfinished threshold and contains no steps.

title: Camera Dolly Blind Set Retreat
description: Carry a low camera head into a 3.2 m blind corridor built inside the studio set. Advance at 0.08 m/s to the start mark, then film while reversing the same 3.2 m at a steady 0.04 m/s. The 0.5 m scenic passage ends at a fixed wall, so retain the camera heading and make no sideways moves or turns.

title: Gallery Label Stand Placement
description: Carry a folded label stand and mounting supplies 11 m across the closed gallery at 0.22 m/s. Turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 4 seconds in the open center, then follow a 1.5 m rear-left diagonal at 0.10 m/s around a bench while keeping the tray facing the installer. Slide right 0.24 m over 12 seconds to the taped handoff outline beside the display plinth.

title: Pick Cartons Between Close Racks
description: Carry a 24 kg carton tray on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body through a 0.46 m rack aisle, keeping the long edge parallel to the racks. Travel 7 m forward, slide right 25 mm to the pickup mark, then slide left and reverse out without turning; allow 40 seconds for each straight leg and 5 seconds for each lateral adjustment.

title: Shuttle a Small Cross-Dock Pallet
description: Carry a 27 kg miniature pallet of sample cartons on a six-module block between two floor-level cross-dock stations. Follow a 10 m forward lane in 44 seconds, turn clockwise 90 degrees in a marked 1.2 m square bay over 4 seconds, then move diagonally front-left 2.4 m in 13 seconds and slide right 0.3 m in 5 seconds to the receiving stop.

title: Rush a Lightweight Packing Tote
description: Carry a 3 kg tote of packing inserts on a four-module square from the shelf buffer to a packing station. Cover the clear 18 m lane forward within 72 seconds, then slide left 0.6 m into the station pocket within 6 seconds while keeping the tote label facing the operator.

title: Scan Racks With Calibrated Optics
description: Carry a 6 kg vibration-sensitive optical scanner on a two-module body along a 12 m rack face, recording shelf labels during a 150-second forward pass. At the end, slide right 0.25 m over 10 seconds to park beside the calibration board without turning the scanner.

title: Collect Cartons Inside a Trailer
description: Move a 16 kg carton stack on a four-module square from inside a parked trailer to the bay handoff across a flush, secured dock plate. Advance through three 2 m sections, allowing 15 seconds per section, and turn clockwise 90 degrees at each of two cleared loading positions in 3 seconds per turn; reverse the final 1 m into the handoff pocket in 10 seconds.

title: Align Frozen Samples at Hatch
description: Carry an 8 kg insulated sample box on a two-module body along a dry cold-room aisle to a transfer hatch. Move forward 3 m in 35 seconds, slide left 80 mm in 12 seconds, and turn counter-clockwise 6 degrees over 4 seconds to place the box against the hatch guides.

title: Feed Glass Vials on Mezzanine
description: Carry a 7 kg cushioned vial tray on a two-module body entirely on the flat mezzanine between a bench and a conveyor loading shelf. Travel forward 5 m in 65 seconds, then slide right 0.4 m over 12 seconds beneath the shelf lip without rotating the tray.

title: Route Returned Camera Equipment
description: Carry an 11 kg padded case of returned camera lenses on three modules arranged in a straight 0.6 by 0.2 m body. Cross the clear sorting square diagonally front-right for 3.6 m in 45 seconds, then reverse 1.2 m into the inspection bench pocket over 20 seconds while keeping the case opening toward the technician.

title: Service Mobile Rack End Panels
description: Carry a 4 kg tag-verification kit on a two-module body through an opened mobile-rack aisle with rack movement locked out. Make four 1.5 m forward advances in 12 seconds each, stopping in widened end-panel pockets to alternate clockwise and counter-clockwise 90-degree turns, each allowed 3 seconds.

title: Present Pharmacy Bins to Checkers
description: Carry a 5 kg sealed prescription bin on a two-module body between three checking desks around a clear central turning pad. Use two 2.5 m forward legs of 20 seconds each, turning counter-clockwise 120 degrees in 4 seconds before each leg, then slide left 0.18 m in 6 seconds for the final barcode check.

title: Dock Supplies Beside Corridor Brace
description: Carry a 23 kg rescue supply crate on a six-module block along a structurally cleared, flat strip through a damaged corridor. Advance 6 m in 50 seconds, then move diagonally front-left 1.4 m over 20 seconds into a marked handoff position beside a brace, keeping the crate square to the corridor.

title: Deliver a Sensitive Gas Analyzer
description: Carry a 6.5 kg portable gas analyzer in its isolated cradle through a smoke-filled office corridor on a two-module body. Move forward 8 m in 100 seconds, slide right 0.5 m through an open doorway over 15 seconds, and reverse 2 m into the sampling position over 30 seconds; the area is cool enough for the equipment.

title: Place Sensors Beside Garage Column
description: Carry a 14 kg structural monitoring case on a four-module square along a swept level route between debris piles in a parking garage. Advance 4 m in 45 seconds, slide left 60 mm in 10 seconds, and turn clockwise 4 degrees over 5 seconds to align the case with a technician's pickup marks beside a column.

title: Carry a Basement Water Probe
description: Carry a 2 kg water-level logger on one splash-protected module along a flat basement service corridor with a continuous 3 mm water film and no submerged openings. Travel forward 24 m to the marked sampling point within 150 seconds, pause for a reading, and reverse the same distance within another 150 seconds without turning.

title: Dock at Tunnel Survey Marker
description: Carry a 3.2 kg survey camera on one module through a cleared indoor service tunnel after a quake. Travel forward 10 m in 70 seconds, then approach the offset charging marker diagonally front-right for 0.85 m over 15 seconds without changing the camera heading.

title: Rush Evacuation Labels to Ward
description: Carry a 1.8 kg packet of evacuation wristbands and route cards on a two-module body down a reserved hospital corridor. Cover 22 m forward within 86 seconds, then slide right 0.45 m into a ward alcove over 5 seconds so the corridor is clear for evacuation teams.

title: Stage Equipment on Stairwell Landing
description: Carry a 25 kg rescue equipment chest on a six-module block entirely across a flat 2.4 m square stairwell landing between two same-level doors. Advance 1 m in 10 seconds, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees in 4 seconds, slide left 0.5 m in 8 seconds, move diagonally rear-right 0.7 m in 10 seconds, and reverse 0.4 m in 8 seconds to the handoff mark.

title: Sample Dead Ends After Fire
description: Carry a 12 kg air-sampling kit on a four-module square into two cooled warehouse rack dead ends. Advance 5 m into each aisle in 40 seconds, pause to sample, then reverse 5 m in another 40 seconds because turning clearance is unavailable; slide right 1.8 m across the clear aisle mouth in 20 seconds between samples.

title: Deliver Supplies Through Train Aisle
description: Carry a 22 kg emergency supply tray on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body already staged inside a stationary train carriage. Travel forward 11 m through the 0.48 m central aisle within 100 seconds to the blocked far vestibule, let responders remove the tray, and reverse the full 11 m within 100 seconds without turning between the seats.

title: Align Refuge Chamber Radio Pack
description: Carry a 4.4 kg replacement radio battery pack on one module across the flat interior of a mine refuge chamber. Advance 1.8 m in 25 seconds, slide left 35 mm over 8 seconds, and turn counter-clockwise 3 degrees over 4 seconds to align the pack's tray with a seated operator's retrieval fixture.

title: Survey a Long Cold Aisle
description: Carry a 9 kg temperature and airflow logging rig on a four-module square along a 36 m data-centre cold aisle. Make a forward measurement pass within 180 seconds, stop at the closed end for a reference reading, and reverse 36 m within another 180 seconds while keeping the sensor face toward the same rack row.

title: Inspect Behind Inverter Cabinets
description: Carry a 7 kg thermal imaging kit on three modules docked in a 0.6 by 0.2 m line inside a solar-farm inverter room. Advance 4.5 m into a narrow cabinet service passage within 40 seconds, stop for thermal images, and reverse out within 45 seconds because the closed end has no turning space.

title: Inspect Beneath a Parked Wing
description: Carry a 5.5 kg upward-looking camera rig on a two-module body along a clear hangar-floor strip beneath a parked aircraft wing. Advance 7 m toward the landing-gear inspection stop within 65 seconds, then reverse the same route within 70 seconds because the stop lies between wheel chocks and offers no turning room.

title: Dock Engine Room Vibration Logger
description: Carry a 15 kg vibration logging case on a four-module square across a dry engine-room deck while the ship is secured alongside. Move forward 5 m in 40 seconds, turn clockwise 45 degrees over 3 seconds in a clear bay, then move diagonally rear-left 1.1 m over 18 seconds into a marked instrument handoff dock between two pump guards.

title: Move Turbine Alignment Instrument Case
description: Carry a 9.6 kg laser-alignment instrument case on a two-module body from the turbine-hall calibration bench to a maintenance station, keeping the dense load centered across both decks. Travel forward 14 m within 120 seconds, then slide left 0.35 m over 14 seconds into the station's floor-level pickup position without rotating the case.

title: Blind Pipe Branch Survey
description: Carry a low camera and gas sensor along three blind branches in the plant's pipe gallery using a three-module straight body. Each branch has a 4.5 m clear section covered in about 30 seconds, followed by a slow inspection stop beneath a valve. Reverse along the same track to the junction because there is no turning space.

title: Enclosed Bridge Bearing Check
description: Take a bearing camera down the enclosed, level maintenance walkway inside the bridge deck. The two-module body travels lengthwise through a 0.34 m opening and covers a clear 7.2 m section in 40 seconds before stopping at the terminal bearing. Reverse out without turning, keeping the camera aimed toward the bearing for the first part of withdrawal.

title: Nacelle Gearbox Leak Survey
description: With the turbine locked out, carry a thermal camera across the level nacelle service floor to inspect gearbox seals. Travel forward along a 2.4 m clear strip in 20 seconds, slide left 0.45 m in 9 seconds to look behind a cabinet, then retrace that slide. In the central clear area, turn clockwise 90 degrees over 6 seconds and leave on a 1.3 m front-right diagonal covered in 10 seconds.

title: Cleanroom Port Camera Alignment
description: Move a particle-counter and camera assembly to three marked inspection ports beside a process tool, using a three-module straight body. Advance along the tool frontage at up to 0.065 m/s, then slide right through the final 60 mm at 0.006 m/s to center each port in the camera. Slide left to clear the tool before advancing to the next mark; maintain the same heading throughout.

title: Parking Column Face Scan
description: Carry a compact crack-scanning mast to a square column on a closed, level parking deck. Approach over a clear 5 m section in 25 seconds, then scan the near face by sliding left and right at 0.035 m/s. Use a 1.4 m front-left diagonal in 10 seconds to reach the adjacent face, and turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees in about 5 seconds within the marked clear pad.

title: Ward Supply Junction Delivery
description: Deliver a secured box of dressings from the supply room to three ward collection points. Travel forward through clear 6 m corridor sections in about 25 seconds each, stopping at the junction pads to turn in place toward the next ward. title: Baggage Tag Stock Replenishment

Slide right after unloading and reverse through the same 0.31 m throat.

title: Indoor Layout Tool Circuit
description: Deliver a restrained box of layout tools to four marked workstations on a swept indoor construction slab. title: Miniature Set Camera Moves

title: Gallery Label Kit Delivery

At the conservator's side table, slide left 0.22 m over 11 seconds for collection, then slide right before backing out.

title: Blind Picking Lane Retrieval
description: Send one module carrying an empty parts tray into a blind picking lane, where a worker places a 3.8 kg bag of fasteners on it. title: Light Pallet Crossdock Shuttle
description: Shuttle a 4.5 kg narrow composite pallet carrying empty foam inserts across a cleared cross-dock lane on a three-module straight body. Keep the same heading and cover the clear 13.25 m section forward in 50 seconds, then reverse along it after the pallet is removed. title: Shelf Tote Packing Transfer

Cross the station apron on a 1.6 m front-left diagonal in 10 seconds, then slide right 0.2 m over 10 seconds to align with the receiving marks.

title: Rack Scanner Diagonal Docking
description: Carry a small barcode camera along a rack face, scanning a clear 7.2 m section in 60 seconds while moving forward. title: Level Trailer Carton Unload
description: Carry a strapped stack of cartons from a worker inside a parked trailer to the receiving table using a two-by-two body. Follow a clear 15.6 m straight section at 0.26 m/s, then reverse along the same route after unloading; no turn is needed.

title: Chilled Ingredient Crate Transfer
description: Move a 14.4 kg chilled ingredient crate on a three-module straight body from a cold-room rack to the weighing bench. Travel forward along a clear 5.6 m aisle section in 40 seconds, then slide left 0.3 m over 15 seconds to present the crate beside the bench. Slide right and reverse after unloading, keeping the long body aligned with the aisle throughout.

title: Mezzanine Conveyor Tray Alignment
description: Already stationed on the mezzanine, carry a small parts tray from the staging bench to a stopped conveyor's manual feed position. Travel forward along a clear 2.7 m section in 30 seconds, then slide right through the last 75 mm at 0.005 m/s to match the tray marks. After staff transfer the tray, slide left and reverse to staging without turning near the conveyor guard.

title: Returned Glassware Inspection Transfer
description: Carry a 19.8 kg divided crate of returned glassware on a three-by-two body from returns intake to the inspection table. Follow a clear 4.8 m straight section in 60 seconds, then cross an open corner on a 0.9 m rear-left diagonal over 18 seconds to preserve the crate's presentation heading. Slide right the final 0.16 m over 16 seconds beside the table, with smooth acceleration throughout.

title: Mobile Rack Pickup Alignment
description: Take a two-by-two body carrying a flat order tray into an opened mobile-rack aisle, with rack movement locked out. Advance along a clear 3.3 m section in 30 seconds, then slide left through the final 80 mm at 0.004 m/s to align the tray with a manual pickup mark. After the picker fills the tray, slide right and reverse out without turning between the rack faces.

title: Pharmacy Verification Tote Circuit
description: Carry a sealed prescription tote from the dispensing cell to the pharmacist's verification bench. Reverse 0.4 m from the dispenser at 0.04 m/s, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees in about 5 seconds on the clear pad, and travel forward along a clear 4.6 m lane in 20 seconds. Take a 0.84 m front-right diagonal over 7 seconds around a fixed desk corner, then slide left the last 0.09 m over 10 seconds into the marked handoff position.

title: Shoring Kit Through Cleared Corridor
description: Carry a 9.6 kg compact shoring kit to the search crew along a cleared, level strip through a collapsed office corridor. The two-module body travels lengthwise through a 0.32 m gap, covering the 8 m approach in about 70 seconds before reversing along the same route. At the delivery recess, slide left 0.18 m in roughly 7 seconds and slide right again after unloading.

title: Office Smoke Survey Circuit
description: Carry a thermal camera and gas sampler around four cleared office junctions on a smoke-filled floor. Move forward between junctions along 3 m legs taking about 20 seconds, stopping on 1.1 m square clear areas to turn in place. Make two clockwise and two counter-clockwise 90-degree turns, allowing about 5 seconds for each turn and settling.

title: Garage Recess Search Passes
description: Carry a camera and listening sensor into three dead-end parking recesses on one level of a damaged garage. Each cleared recess is 5 m deep and only 0.34 m wide between debris boundaries, so enter forward in about 32 seconds and reverse out in about 43 seconds without turning. Slide right 0.9 m across the clear entrance apron between recesses, allowing about 12 seconds per transfer.

title: Basement Pump Delivery
description: Carry a 19 kg portable pump and coiled discharge hose across a basement with a uniform 5 mm layer of water on a flat floor. Use a water-protected four-module square body to travel forward 10 m in about 100 seconds along a surveyed clear route. Slide right 0.6 m into the pump staging position over about 15 seconds, unload, then slide left and reverse to the starting area.

title: Tunnel Sensor Relay Run
description: Carry a radio relay and crack camera 48 m into a level service tunnel after a quake. The inspected route is straight and clear, with a 0.6 m minimum passage between temporary supports; reach the survey mark in about 190 seconds. Pause for a camera sweep, then reverse the full distance without turning.

title: Evacuation Station Oxygen Delivery
description: Carry a secured 7.2 kg emergency oxygen kit from the corridor supply point to a staffed evacuation station. Travel forward 12 m in about 65 seconds, then approach its angled receiving tray diagonally front-left along a 0.85 m path over about 12 seconds while keeping the kit facing the attendant. After unloading, withdraw diagonally rear-right and reverse down the corridor.

title: Landing Door Listening Check
description: Carry a listening unit along the flat stairwell landing to a blocked fire door, using three modules docked in a straight row. Remain on the landing throughout and do not turn near the stair opening.

title: Engine Room Gauge Survey

title: Turbine Hall Thermal Traverse

Turn counter-clockwise in place through 90 degrees on the 1.2 m inspection pad, allowing about 6 seconds, then reverse 0.8 m into the marked measurement position.

title: Nacelle Cabinet Side Scan
description: Carry a compact inspection camera on a four-module square body along a stationary wind turbine's level nacelle floor. Record the column face and withdraw diagonally rear-right along the same route without changing heading.

title: Feed Mezzanine Conveyor Parts Tray

title: Dock Returned Electronics Bin

title: Search Smoke-Obscured Office Alcove
description: Take a 9 kg thermal-camera and air-monitor package on a 2-by-3 body 8 m forward into an office corridor ending at a locked records room. title: Deliver Radio Beside Garage Column
description: Carry a 4 kg radio and medical pouch on a two-module body along 5 m of swept parking-garage slab in about 45 seconds. Follow a cleared 1.6 m diagonal front-left lane between debris piles in about 20 seconds to a responder handoff mat beside a column.

title: Rush Sensor to Tunnel Team
description: Carry a 2 kg replacement gas sensor on a square four-module body along a surveyed, clear 30 m indoor service-tunnel section after a quake. Drive straight forward to the waiting inspection team in about 120 seconds, slowing only near the handoff point.

title: Recover Heat-Damaged Evidence Recorder

title: Cold Aisle Thermal Survey
description: Carry a thermal camera along a closed data-centre cold aisle on a two-module body arranged lengthwise. title: Inverter Alarm Camera Dispatch

title: Wing Underside Camera Traverse

title: Engine Room Acoustic Instrument Delivery

Slide left 0.42 m over 14 seconds to place the instrument beside the pump skid.

title: Pipe Gallery Optical Reference Transfer
description: Carry a padded optical reference assembly to a survey position in a level indoor pipe gallery on two modules docked lengthwise. Reverse the diagonal to clear the measurement position, then back out without rotating the fragile assembly.

title: Bridge Walkway Sensor Delivery

Slide left and reverse to the access room, keeping the fragile box square to the walkway throughout.

title: Nacelle Gearbox Camera Alignment
description: Position a camera fixture beside a gearbox inspection window on the continuous flat nacelle floor during a turbine shutdown.
