Make a clockwise 6-degree correction over 12 seconds and hold still for the inspection.

title: Cleanroom Particle Counter Docking
description: Move a cleanroom-approved particle counter on a lengthwise pair of modules to a marked sampling position beside a process tool. Advance 2.1 m over 30 seconds, slide right 0.09 m over 15 seconds, and turn counter-clockwise 4 degrees over 10 seconds to align the sampling head. Reverse out after sampling, without crossing the adjacent operator standing zone.

title: Parking Column Crack Imaging
description: Carry a close-range camera to three marked viewpoints beside a column on a flat indoor parking level closed to vehicles. Advance 1.8 m over 20 seconds, then slide left and right between viewpoints spaced 0.15 m apart, taking 10 seconds per lateral move. At the centre viewpoint, turn 12 degrees clockwise and back counter-clockwise over 8 seconds each to frame the crack edges.

title: Hospital Dressing Supply Delivery

At the ward, slide right 0.4 m over 10 seconds into the alcove without turning the tote.

title: Late Night Breakfast Tray Run
description: Deliver a restrained tray of packaged pastries and bottled juice on a two-module body along an empty hotel service corridor. Slide left 0.3 m over 10 seconds to present the tray at the room-service pickup shelf.

title: Baggage Inspection Bench Circuit
description: Move a 16 kg cabin bag in a shallow cradle on a four-module square body between three inspection benches in a segregated baggage hall. The circuit requires two clockwise 90-degree turns and one counter-clockwise 90-degree turn, each completed over 3 seconds.

title: Assembly Fixture Pocket Refill

Advance 3.3 m in 30 seconds, then slide left 0.16 m over 8 seconds to place the tote beside the assembly fixture. Slide right to centre the body and reverse the full 3.3 m because the 0.48 m pocket is too narrow for a turn.

title: Reserved Book Return Express

Turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 6 seconds to present the tray's labelled edge.

title: Laboratory Sample Corridor Transfer
description: Transport a sealed temperature-controlled sample carrier on three modules docked in a straight row from preparation to analysis. Travel forward along a 28.8 m corridor in 160 seconds of cruise, keeping the carrier aligned through a 0.7 m doorway. At the receiving bay, slide left 0.36 m over 18 seconds to the handoff mark, then slide right and reverse home after unloading.

title: Glassware Carton Backroom Restock
description: Carry two padded cartons of drinking glasses on a six-module 0.6 m by 0.4 m body from receiving to a backroom shelf. Move forward 7.2 m over 90 seconds, then turn clockwise 90 degrees over 15 seconds in a marked 1.2 m turning square. Slide right 0.45 m over 15 seconds to the shelf handoff line, keeping both cartons strapped low on the deck.

title: Interior Layout Kit Express
description: Deliver a light layout kit on a four-module square body across a completed indoor construction slab during a cleared delivery window. Cover a 13.5 m straight strip in 50 seconds at cruise, then cross a 3.9 m front-left diagonal in 15 seconds through an open room. Slide right 0.48 m over 8 seconds to leave the kit beside the surveyor's marked work position.

title: Tabletop Camera Dolly Take
description: Carry a compact camera and low bracket on a two-module body for a tabletop product shot on a level studio floor. During the take, slide right 0.72 m over 36 seconds while keeping the camera aimed at the set, then move forward 0.24 m over 16 seconds for the close-up. Between takes, reverse the approach, slide left to the start, and make a clockwise 3-degree framing correction over 10 seconds.

title: Gallery Label Kit Circuit
description: Carry a secured case of replacement labels and mounting supplies between four museum workstations after closing, using three modules docked in a straight row. Travel forward along 3.6 m links in 30 seconds each and turn in place on the marked 1 m-wide pads outside the exhibit cases. Alternate clockwise and counter-clockwise 90-degree turns over 5 seconds each so the case handle faces each technician.

title: Dead End Small Parts Picking
description: Take an order tote into a blind-ended picking aisle using three modules docked in a straight row. Advance 6.4 m in 40 seconds of cruise, then slide right 0.08 m over 8 seconds at the marked picking stop. After the picker loads the tote, slide left to centre and reverse the full aisle because its 0.42 m width does not permit the 0.6 m-long body to turn.

title: Mini Pallet Cross Dock Shuttle
description: Shuttle a loaded 0.6 m by 0.4 m mini pallet between cross-dock sorting lanes on a six-module rectangular body; staff load and unload it at rest. Cover 8.8 m forward links in 40 seconds each and turn in place at the 1.2 m intersection squares to face the next lane. Each circuit includes clockwise and counter-clockwise 90-degree turns over 3 seconds each, followed by a rightward 0.3 m docking slide over 10 seconds.

title: Single Tote Packing Station Loop
description: Carry a small lidded tote from a low shelf handoff point to two packing stations on a single module. Follow 2.4 m forward links in 20 seconds each, turning in place clockwise 90 degrees at the first station and counter-clockwise 90 degrees at the second, allowing 2 seconds per turn. At each station, slide left 0.12 m over 6 seconds for handoff and right again before continuing.

title: Rack Label Inventory Sweep
description: Carry a side-facing barcode camera along two rack faces using a lengthwise pair of modules. Scan each 30 m straight run in 125 seconds of cruise, then slide right 1.2 m over 12 seconds through the clear end cross-aisle. Reverse down the second rack face without turning so the camera continues facing left toward the labels.

title: Trailer Parcel Batch Unload
description: Carry a strapped batch of small parcels from a parked trailer to three receiving positions using three modules docked in a straight row, with workers loading the deck. Travel forward along 7.5 m links in 50 seconds, using only a verified level, flush bridge between the trailer floor and the indoor bay. Turn in place 90 degrees over 4 seconds at the 1.1 m receiving pads, alternating clockwise and counter-clockwise to present the parcels, then reverse along the trailer lane for the next batch.

title: Frozen Ingredient Tote Transfer
description: Carry a 14.4 kg insulated ingredient tote on three modules docked in a line from a freezer pick face to the packing vestibule. Drive forward along the 12 m clear aisle in a 60 s steady travel segment, then slide right 0.3 m over 10 s to line up with the unloading shelf. Keep the long body facing down the aisle throughout.

title: Four Station Conveyor Feed
description: Move a 7 kg carton tray between four conveyor induction stations on a guarded, level mezzanine using a 2x2 body. Each station is 2.4 m from the next, with a 15 s steady forward leg and a 90-degree clockwise turn in place over 3 s at each marked turning pad. Operators transfer cartons only after the body stops.

title: Returns Tray Scale Placement
description: Bring a 6.2 kg returns tray on a three-module line into the marked bay beside a bench scale. Advance 1.8 m in a 30 s steady segment, slide left 0.12 m over 12 s, and turn counter-clockwise 4 degrees over 4 s to match the scale guide. After staff remove the tray, reverse 1.8 m along the same approach.

title: Dense Rack Battery Delivery
description: Carry a secured 9.6 kg replacement battery cassette on a fore-aft pair through an opened mobile-rack aisle. Travel forward 7.2 m in a 60 s steady segment, then slide left 0.18 m over 9 s into the marked handoff position without changing heading. Reverse out after the cassette is removed.

title: Urgent Pharmacy Tote Shuttle
description: Carry a 1.3 kg lidded prescription tote on a 2x2 body from the dispensing cell to the checking bench. The reserved straight lane includes a 13 m steady transit segment that must take 50 s, followed by a right slide of 0.24 m over 8 s into the bench bay. Keep the tote facing the checker throughout.

title: Corridor Void Camera Delivery
description: Take a 1.8 kg camera and two-way speaker on a fore-aft pair down a cleared strip of intact corridor floor to inspect a gap beneath a fallen partition. Advance 4.2 m over a 70 s steady segment, then slide right 0.08 m over 8 s through a 0.25 m-wide offset throat opening into a wider observation pocket. Slide left again and reverse out after the search team reviews the view.

title: Office Doorway Thermal Check
description: Position a 3.2 kg thermal camera and air sampler on a 2x2 body outside a smoke-filled office doorway. Follow the cleared 3 m corridor segment forward in 50 s, slide left 0.15 m over 15 s to center the sensor view, and turn clockwise 6 degrees over 6 s to aim through the door opening. Hold for the incident operator's reading before reversing along the approach.

title: Garage Shoring Tool Handoff
description: Deliver an 11 kg case of shoring wedges on a 2x2 body across a swept, level section of parking garage to the rescue crew. Travel forward 5.6 m in a 40 s steady segment, then slide left 0.6 m over 20 s between two fixed debris piles through a 0.46 m-wide cross passage. Slide right back through the passage and reverse to staging after unloading.

title: Basement Water Level Check
description: Send one splash-protected module carrying a 0.7 kg camera and water-depth probe along the flat basement service strip. In a verified 3 mm film of water, move forward 2.4 m in a 60 s steady segment and slide right 0.06 m over 6 s to sight a gauge through a 0.24 m-wide gap between a pipe guard and a cabinet. Slide left to recenter and reverse out after the reading.

title: Tunnel Joint Camera Alignment
description: Carry a 2.6 kg illuminated crack camera on a fore-aft pair along the intact, level tunnel maintenance strip to a marked lining joint. Drive forward through a 6.3 m steady segment in 70 s, slide left 0.09 m over 9 s, and turn counter-clockwise 3 degrees over 6 s to align the camera with the joint. Reverse along the strip after recording.

title: Evacuation Supply Cart Docking
description: Bring a secured 23 kg load of blankets and sealed respiratory supply packs on a 2x3 body to a staffed evacuation transfer point. Advance along the 8.4 m clear corridor segment in 70 s, then slide right 0.2 m over 20 s and turn clockwise 5 degrees over 5 s inside the broad transfer alcove. Stop with the deck aligned beside the supply cart for manual unloading.

title: Extended Landing Supply Run
description: Move an 18 kg case of rescue lighting batteries on a 2x3 body along the unusually long, flat transfer landing between two enclosed stair cores. The route stays entirely on the same level and includes an 18.2 m straight segment covered forward in 70 s, with slow stopping at the crew's marked unload point. Reverse along the same straight route after unloading; no part of the job enters either stair flight.

title: Fire Recovery Sensor Docking
description: Carry a 12 kg sealed atmosphere-monitoring case on a 2x3 body from the recovery staging line to a sampling dock on a cooled warehouse floor. Drive forward 5.1 m in a 30 s steady segment, then approach the dock diagonally front-left for 1.2 m along the diagonal path over 20 s to pass a fixed hose reel. After sampling, withdraw diagonally rear-right along the same path and reverse to staging.

title: Carriage Seat Row Search
description: Take a 0.9 kg camera and speaker on one module through a stationary, level train carriage to check beneath a seat row. Drive forward 4.8 m in a 40 s steady segment, slide left 0.24 m over 8 s into the seat bay, and turn clockwise 90 degrees over 6 s in the clear bay center. Move diagonally front-right 0.3 m over 6 s to obtain the view, then retrace that diagonal, undo the turn, slide right, and reverse down the aisle.

title: Refuge Chamber Supply Shuttle
description: Deliver a 17 kg box of drinking-water pouches and breathing-mask cartridges on a 2x2 body along a refuge chamber's level service annex. The straight outbound route includes a 22.5 m steady segment scheduled for 90 s before the staffed handoff point. Reverse along the same lane after unloading because the terminal bay has no turning space.

title: Cold Aisle Thermal Survey
description: Carry a 4.8 kg thermal and airflow instrument on a 2x3 body down a data-centre cold aisle. Drive forward 10.8 m in a 60 s steady segment, slide left 0.18 m over 9 s at a rack face and right again, then move diagonally front-right 0.8 m over 8 s through the open end bay. Turn counter-clockwise 180 degrees over 6 s on the marked 1.2 m-square pad before driving forward into the adjacent aisle.

title: Inverter Room Thermal Sprint
description: Move a 1.6 kg thermal recorder on a 2x3 body between two inverter banks inside a level equipment room. Cross the clear floor diagonally front-left along a 10.4 m path in a 40 s steady segment to capture the second bank during the same operating interval. Finish with a right slide of 0.15 m over 5 s to center on its marked observation position.

title: Underwing Panel Camera Pass
description: Carry a 2.4 kg upward-facing panel camera on a 2x2 body beneath a parked aircraft wing. Advance 3.6 m in a 30 s steady segment, then slide right 1.2 m over 40 s through a 0.45 m-wide corridor between padded maintenance fixtures while keeping the camera square to the panel seam. Slide left back through the corridor and reverse to the inspection station.

title: Engine Room Analyzer Positioning
description: Carry an 18.8 kg vibration analyzer and contact-probe kit on a 2x2 body across a dry, level engine-room deck while the ship is alongside. Travel forward 4.4 m in a 40 s steady segment and turn clockwise 90 degrees over 10 s in the clear service bay. Slide left 0.24 m over 12 s beside the machinery guard so a technician can attach the probe leads.

title: Turbine Hall Reading Shuttle
description: Carry a 1.2 kg dosimeter and thermal logger on a 2x2 body between two marked turbine-hall observation points. The reserved straight lane has a 16.2 m steady segment that must be covered forward in 60 s during the scheduled reading window. Pause at the second point, then reverse over the same segment to the collection station.

title: Pipe Gallery Acoustic Circuit
description: Carry a 1.7 kg acoustic leak recorder on a 2x2 body along the flat pipe-gallery service lane. Travel forward through a 12.5 m steady segment in 50 s, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 2.5 s in the widened end bay, and continue forward along the branch to the second recording mark. The recorder takes readings only while stopped.

title: Bridge Bearing Walkway Survey
description: Carry a 3.4 kg bearing-inspection camera on a 2x2 body along an enclosed, level maintenance walkway beneath the bridge deck. Enter each dead-end bearing pocket forward, using an 8.4 m steady segment over 60 s on the longest pocket, then slide right 0.1 m over 10 s for the image and left again. Reverse the full pocket length because its 0.52 m width does not permit the body to turn.

title: Nacelle Oil Analyzer Delivery
description: Move a 14.2 kg portable oil analyzer on three modules docked fore-aft from the nacelle's flat lift receiving pad to the gearbox sampling station. With the turbine parked, advance 2.7 m along the level service strip in a 45 s steady segment, then slide right 0.12 m over 12 s into the sampling position. After the technician finishes and removes the analyzer, slide left and reverse to the receiving pad.

title: Cleanroom Reference Plate Transfer
description: Carry a 3.6 kg sealed optical reference-plate cassette on a fore-aft pair from its cleanroom storage stand to the inspection tool's loading mark. Use gentle acceleration into a 2.4 m forward segment covered in 60 s, then slide left 0.08 m over 16 s and turn clockwise 2 degrees over 8 s to align the cassette handle with the tool guide. A technician lifts the cassette after the body settles.

title: Parking Column Base Scan
description: Position a 1.1 kg close-range scanner on one module at three marked views around a parking-structure column base. Approach forward through a 1.5 m steady segment in 30 s, slide left 0.12 m over 12 s to center the first target, and turn counter-clockwise 30 degrees over 10 s for the second view. Move diagonally rear-right 0.18 m over 12 s to the third mark, stopping fully for each scan.

title: Deliver Glass Infusion Bottles
description: Carry a padded crate of glass infusion bottles from hospital stores to the ward supply alcove on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body. Cruise forward along the 18 m corridor in 150 seconds, keeping the crate level over flush floor joints. At the alcove, slide left 0.45 m over 15 seconds without rotating; staff unload the bottles.

title: Dock Breakfast Tray Carrier
description: Take a covered breakfast tray on a four-module square body from the service pantry to a room-service handoff pedestal. Travel forward along the 9 m carpeted corridor at a 75-second cruise pace, then approach the pedestal diagonally front-right across a 0.84 m path in 12 seconds. Keep the tray facing the guest-room doors throughout the approach.

title: Return Misrouted Cabin Bag
description: Carry one small cabin bag from the baggage exception desk to a low receiving nest beside the reclaim conveyor. Cross a marked 13 m service lane forward at a 50-second cruise pace, then move diagonally front-left along a 1.2 m guide stripe in 10 seconds. The bag stays strapped lengthwise on the two-module body, and an attendant lifts it off at the nest.

title: Exchange Assembly Fixture Kits
description: Deliver a tray of assembly fixtures into a 4.8 m blind line-side pocket using a four-module square body. Enter forward at a 40-second cruise pace, wait while the operator exchanges trays, then reverse out at the same pace because the pocket has no turning bay. Once clear, slide right 0.6 m in 10 seconds into the marked return lane.

title: Move Dense Book Returns
description: Carry a compact bin of returned reference books from the library intake hatch to the sorting desk. The two-module body travels forward along a 7.2 m shelving aisle at a 60-second cruise pace, then turns clockwise through 90 degrees in six seconds inside a clear junction. Slide left 0.36 m in six seconds to put the heavy bin within the librarian's reach.

title: Transfer Sealed Assay Samples
description: Move a secured sample cooler from laboratory accession to the analyzer handoff shelf on a four-module square body. Cruise forward along the 6 m aisle in 40 seconds, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees in five seconds at the junction, and follow a 0.72 m front-right diagonal into the handoff bay in nine seconds. Slide left 0.16 m in eight seconds for shelf alignment, then reverse 1.2 m in 12 seconds after staff remove the cooler.

title: Restock Blind Stockroom Bay
description: Take a carton of shampoo refills into a 3.6 m dead-end bay behind the retail stock shelves. The two modules are docked lengthwise so their 0.2 m width fits the narrow passage; enter forward at a 30-second cruise pace. After the stock clerk unloads the carton, reverse the entire 3.6 m at a 40-second cruise pace without turning or sliding sideways.

title: Rush Survey Targets Indoors
description: Carry a light case of laser survey targets across a swept indoor construction slab to the layout crew. Use a 24.3 m straight lane with a 90-second forward cruise, then take a 2.4 m front-left diagonal across the open staging square in 10 seconds. Stop at the crew's marked collection point without rotating the body.

title: Repeat Straight Camera Passes
description: Carry a compact remote camera on a low mount along an 8.4 m studio tracking lane. Make the forward filming pass at a 70-second cruise pace, then reverse along the same line at a 35-second cruise pace to reset for another take. Keep the body heading fixed and all cables off the floor.

title: Relocate Bronze Display Base
description: Move a small bronze display base in a padded cradle from the museum preparation bench to a gallery plinth after closing. A single module carries the dense load forward over a 4.5 m route at a 50-second cruise pace. Slide right 0.24 m in 12 seconds between the plinth feet so the conservator can lift the base straight up.

title: Collect Dense Fastener Bin
description: Send one module into a narrow picking aisle to collect a compact bin of steel fasteners from a low handoff shelf. Travel forward 6.6 m at a 60-second cruise pace, then slide left 0.12 m in six seconds beneath the handoff mark. After the picker loads the bin, slide right to the aisle center and reverse out along the same route.

title: Shuttle Sample Mini Pallet
description: Carry a 0.18 m square sample mini pallet holding a boxed valve across the cross-dock on one module. Cruise forward along the 10.4 m marked lane in 40 seconds, then follow a 1.05 m front-right diagonal into a floor-level receiving nest in 15 seconds. A worker removes the mini pallet; no full-size freight pallet is involved.

title: Thread Tote Through Guide Rails
description: Carry a narrow electronics tote from a shelf handoff to a packing station on one module. Advance 3.2 m through a straight guide-rail passage at a 40-second cruise pace, with only 35 mm clearance on each side of the body. At the wider station mouth, slide left 0.18 m in 15 seconds to align the tote with the pickup marks without yawing.

title: Scan Alternating Rack Faces
description: Carry a short barcode camera mast on a four-module square body through six inventory scan stations spaced 2.4 m apart. Cruise forward between stations at 0.16 m/s, covering each interval in 15 seconds. At each station, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees in two seconds to scan the left rack, turn clockwise 180 degrees in four seconds to scan the right rack, then turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees to face down the aisle again.

title: Receive Trailer Inspection Cases
description: Use three modules docked lengthwise to carry an inspection-equipment case from a trailer's rear receiving position to the bay table. The trailer is immobilized with its floor level to a secured flush bridge plate; advance 2.1 m across this route at a 30-second cruise pace. At the table, slide right 0.09 m in nine seconds, then creep forward the final 0.12 m in 12 seconds to meet the transfer marks.

title: Run Chilled Reagent Shuttle
description: Carry a small insulated reagent box from the cold-room entrance to the far-end handoff shelf on one module. The straight 21.6 m aisle is dry and clear, allowing a 90-second forward cruise. After a technician exchanges the box, reverse down the same aisle at the same pace because the shelf end has no turning space.

title: Feed Mezzanine Conveyor Nest
description: Carry a narrow carton tray from the mezzanine packing bench to a low conveyor loading nest using three modules in a lengthwise row. Remain on the same mezzanine level and cruise forward along the 5.4 m guarded aisle in 30 seconds. Approach the nest diagonally front-left over a 0.9 m guide path in 15 seconds, keeping the long body parallel to the conveyor.

title: Collect Returned Handset Trays
description: Collect a tray of returned handsets from a test-bench nest on a three-module lengthwise body. Starting in the central sorting lane, move diagonally rear-right along a 1.32 m marked approach in 12 seconds so the tray's pickup edge stays facing the technician. After loading, retrace the path diagonally front-left, then travel forward 4.2 m to the sorting table at a 30-second cruise pace.

title: Dock Within Mobile Racking
description: Take a narrow archive-parts tray down the temporarily opened aisle of a mobile-racking system on three modules docked lengthwise. With rack motion interlocked off, cruise forward 7 m in 50 seconds to the widened end pocket. Move diagonally front-right along a 0.48 m path in 12 seconds to the floor-level pickup nest, then withdraw diagonally rear-left and reverse out after unloading.

title: Align Prescription Cassette Carrier
description: Carry a sealed prescription cassette on two modules docked side by side, forming a body 0.4 m wide and 0.2 m long. Travel forward 2.8 m through the 0.46 m pharmacy-cell passage at a 35-second cruise pace. In the wider handoff pocket, slide right 0.14 m in 14 seconds to align the cassette label with the fixed reader, then slide left before reversing out.

title: Probe Cleared Corridor Slot
description: Send a low thermal camera and microphone into a structurally cleared corridor segment beside fallen ceiling panels, using three modules in a lengthwise row. Advance 3 m along the swept, flat 0.32 m slot at a 50-second cruise pace without climbing debris. At a wider opening, slide left 0.12 m in 12 seconds to look through a doorway gap, slide right to recenter, then reverse out.

title: Dock Smoke Survey Relay
description: Carry a thermal survey head and radio relay on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body to a marked observation dock inside a smoke-filled office floor. Follow the mapped 10.8 m cleared corridor forward at a 90-second cruise pace, then turn clockwise 90 degrees in three seconds in the open reception area. Approach the wall dock diagonally front-left over 1.2 m in 20 seconds so the relay antenna keeps its planned orientation.

title: Search Garage Debris Recess
description: Carry a camera and acoustic sensor into a blind recess between debris piles on a parking garage's level slab. The two-module lengthwise body advances 5.4 m along a swept channel at a 60-second cruise pace and pauses to listen near the blocked end. Reverse the full distance at a 90-second cruise pace because the channel offers no turning space; do not cross rubble or use the garage ramps.

title: Recover Fragile Water Samples
description: Carry a foam rack of sealed glass water-sample vials from a basement sampling point to the dry recovery station on three modules docked lengthwise. Use splash-protected modules on a surveyed flat route with no more than 3 mm of standing water, cruising forward 4.8 m in 80 seconds. At the dry station, slide right 0.24 m in 12 seconds to present the rack for lifting without turning or jolting the vials.

title: Survey Level Tunnel Reach
description: Carry a low lidar, gas monitor, and lighting battery on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body through a cleared service-tunnel reach after a quake. Cruise forward along the straight 48 m level floor in 200 seconds, stopping at four marked points for readings. At the surveyed 1.5 m turning bay, turn counter-clockwise 180 degrees in six seconds and drive forward back to the entry at the same cruise pace.

title: Align Evacuation Supply Tray
description: Carry a 7 kg tray of evacuation masks along a cleared hospital corridor to a supply receiver beside a fire door. The two-module body travels forward along 6 m at a 50-second cruise pace, then slides left 0.24 m over 12 seconds to align the tray within 10 mm of the receiver. After staff remove the tray, reverse through the same corridor.

title: Rush Landing Radio Batteries
description: Move a 3 kg battery case between two rescue staging tables on one flat stairwell landing, with the four modules docked as a 0.4 m square. The screened route has a 5.2 m straight section requiring a 20-second cruise, followed by a clockwise 90-degree turn in three seconds inside a marked turning square. Drive forward along the final short leg to the receiving table.

title: Distribute Fire Assessment Sensors
description: Carry a 9 kg sensor case through a warehouse bay released for entry after the fire, using three modules in a straight row. Advance along cleared 3.2 m lanes at a 20-second cruise pace, stopping in 0.9 m turning pockets to turn in place toward each marked delivery position. The route alternates clockwise and counter-clockwise 90-degree turns, each taking four seconds.

title: Dock Carriage Medical Supplies
description: Deliver a 12 kg medical pack through a stationary train carriage on a level track, using a four-module square body. Travel forward down the 7.2 m cleared aisle at a 40-second cruise pace, then approach the responder's receiver diagonally front-right along a 0.84 m path over 12 seconds. Reverse straight out after unloading, keeping the body orientation fixed throughout.

title: Retrieve Refuge Air Monitor
description: Retrieve an unattended 4 kg air-monitor case from a dead-end equipment recess inside a mine refuge chamber. The two-module body enters forward along a 2.8 m lane at a 20-second cruise pace, then reverses along that lane after an attendant secures the case. At the open end it slides right 0.48 m over eight seconds to reach the collection table without turning.

title: Dock Cold Aisle Scanner
description: Carry a 6 kg airflow scanner on three modules arranged in a straight row down a data-centre cold aisle. Cruise forward along 9.6 m in 60 seconds, then move diagonally front-left along a 0.72 m path over 12 seconds into an offset calibration dock in the end cross-aisle. Leave the dock diagonally rear-right along the same path before reversing down the aisle.

title: Position Inverter Thermal Recorder
description: Move a 5 kg thermal recorder between an inverter-room storage shelf and a floor calibration dock. Drive forward along a 4.5 m clear lane at a 30-second cruise pace, then follow a 0.9 m front-right diagonal over ten seconds to enter the dock between cabinet plinths. Keep the two-module body parallel to the cabinets throughout the approach.

title: Carry Underwing Inspection Rig
description: Carry a 28 kg inspection rig beneath a parked aircraft wing on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body. Cruise forward along a 12 m marked lane in 80 seconds, then slide left 1.2 m over 20 seconds to place the upward-facing sensor beneath the access panel. After the scan, slide right along the same path and reverse out without turning beneath the wing.

title: Shuttle Engine Room Recorder
description: Shuttle a 2 kg vibration recorder across a ship's engine room while the vessel is secured alongside, using a two-module body. The cleared deck route requires forward cruise along 10.4 m in 40 seconds, followed by a right slide of 0.6 m over five seconds into a technician's receiving bay. Slide left to leave the bay and reverse along the same route after the recorder is read.

title: Traverse Turbine Instrument Gap
description: Carry an 8 kg acoustic inspection package on a four-module square body through a 0.48 m gap between turbine-hall instrument bases. Enter the gap forward, then slide right along its 1.8 m transverse section over 30 seconds while preserving the package's orientation. Slide left back through that section and reverse along the 3.6 m entry lane at a 30-second cruise pace.

title: Survey Long Pipe Gallery
description: Carry a 23 kg recording package along a straight indoor pipe gallery on a six-module rectangular body. Cruise forward along the 52 m survey section in 200 seconds, stopping at marked positions for upward images. At the clear end bay, turn in place clockwise through 180 degrees over eight seconds and drive forward back to the entry.

title: Align Bearing Inspection Camera
description: Position a 10 kg upward-looking camera on an enclosed, level maintenance walkway beneath a bridge deck. The four-module square body cruises forward along 4.8 m in 40 seconds, then slides left 0.18 m over 12 seconds and turns counter-clockwise six degrees over four seconds to frame a bearing label. After imaging, undo the small turn, slide right and reverse to the access room.

title: Align Nacelle Borescope Station
description: Move a 7 kg borescope station across the level service floor inside a locked-out wind-turbine nacelle, using a four-module square body. Advance 1.8 m at a 30-second cruise pace, then slide right 0.16 m over eight seconds to match a gearbox inspection stand. Reverse 0.12 m over six seconds for final stand clearance, preserving orientation throughout.

title: Deliver Cleanroom Metrology Standard
description: Transport a 29 kg metrology standard in a sealed cradle across a semiconductor cleanroom bay on a six-module body. Cruise forward along the 8.4 m service lane in 60 seconds, then move diagonally front-left along a 1.12 m path over 16 seconds into the inspection station. After the measurement, withdraw diagonally rear-right and reverse along the lane.

title: Scan Parking Column Row
description: Carry a 4 kg column-imaging package along a closed, level parking-structure aisle. The two-module body cruises forward along 48 m in 200 seconds, pausing at six columns and sliding left 0.6 m over six seconds at each scan position. Slide right after each scan and reverse the full aisle to return; the route excludes vehicle ramps.

title: Restock Hospital Dressing Store
description: Carry 26 kg of dressing packs in latched bins from central stores to a ward supply room on a six-module body. Follow a 65 m straight service corridor at a 250-second cruise pace, then turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over five seconds inside the supply-room turning bay. Drive forward to the receiving mark for staff unloading.

title: Deliver Hotel Breakfast Boxes
description: Carry 6 kg of closed breakfast boxes from the service pantry to three staffed collection points off a hotel corridor. The two-module body cruises forward along 6.6 m corridor sections in 30 seconds and turns in place toward each collection point inside widened alcoves. Alternate clockwise and counter-clockwise 90-degree turns over three seconds each to face staff and then resume the route.

title: Rush Baggage Routing Labels
description: Move a 2.5 kg box of replacement routing labels between two desks inside the airport baggage hall's segregated service area. Three modules in a straight row cruise forward along 13.5 m in 50 seconds, then take a 2.08 m front-left diagonal across a clear square in eight seconds. Keep the box facing the receiving desk and finish with a slow straight approach.

title: Present Assembly Fastener Kits
description: Carry an 8 kg partitioned fastener tray to four line-side stations on a two-module body. Cruise forward along 3.6 m links at an 18-second pace, turning in place clockwise or counter-clockwise through 90 degrees over 2.5 seconds to present the tray's labeled edge at each station. At the last station, reverse 0.45 m over five seconds before turning back toward the return lane.

title: Return Fragile Folio Volumes
description: Move 14 kg of fragile returned folio volumes in padded horizontal boxes from the library returns desk to the conservation bench on a four-module square body. Cruise forward along a 9.6 m staff aisle in 80 seconds, then slide left 0.42 m over 14 seconds beside the bench. Reverse along the aisle after unloading, using gentle starts and stops to protect brittle bindings.

title: Transfer Sealed Laboratory Samples
description: Carry a 6 kg sealed sample carrier from the preparation bench to the analyzer room on a two-module body. Cruise forward along 5.4 m in 30 seconds, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over six seconds, and slide right 0.36 m over six seconds through an offset doorway. Approach the receiving stand diagonally front-left along 0.64 m over eight seconds, then reverse 0.3 m over five seconds after unloading.

title: Restock Narrow Backroom Shelf
description: Carry 17 kg of boxed toiletries on a four-module square body to a retail backroom shelf through a 0.46 m passage between fixed rack ends. Cruise forward along the 4.2 m approach in 35 seconds, then slide left 1.2 m over 24 seconds through the narrow transverse passage without turning. Slide right to withdraw and reverse to the receiving area after staff unload the boxes.

title: Rush Interior Layout Markers
description: Deliver a 2 kg case of layout markers across a cleared indoor construction slab between two survey crews. The two-module body cruises forward along 10.8 m in 40 seconds, then crosses an open marked zone diagonally front-right along a 3.12 m path in 12 seconds. Stop at the receiving mat for hand collection; the route stays on one finished, level slab.

title: Reposition Low Camera Dolly
description: Carry a 7.5 kg low-mounted camera package between three marked dolly positions on a film-studio floor. Travel forward along 2.4 m links at a 20-second cruise pace, then turn in place clockwise or counter-clockwise through 45 degrees over five seconds to face each set. At the final mark, slide left 0.54 m over nine seconds for the framing correction, with the camera secured against overturning.

title: Move Gallery Display Ballast
description: Carry a 9.5 kg display ballast cassette from the museum preparation room to a floor-mounted display base after closing. The two-module body cruises forward along a 7.7 m gallery route in 70 seconds, then slides right 0.28 m over eight seconds to align the cassette with the staff transfer cradle. After staff lift it off, slide left and reverse to the preparation room without turning near the exhibits.
